name: Abyssal Apparition
stats: Spells cast by Apparition deal (60-50)% less Damage
description: Consume a Power Charge when you cast a damaging Spell to trigger an Abyssal Apparition who will also cast that same Spell for you. Does not work with Channelling Spells, Spells with a Cooldown, Triggered Spells, Spells granted by items, or Spells which already consume a Power Charge. This Skill is not directly Supportable.
skillStats: Spells cast by Apparition deal (60-50)% less Damage

beginner.whatItIs: A passive trigger that spends one of your Power Charges whenever you cast a damaging spell, and has a ghostly double cast the same spell again at roughly half strength.
beginner.whyItMatters: It turns Power Charges into free extra casts, so a build that generates charges faster than it can spend them gets a second helping of damage without pressing another button.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Slot it once you have a reliable Power Charge generator and a single big spell you cast constantly. It ignores channelled spells, cooldown spells and anything already triggered, so it is wasted on those.

name: Acidic Concoction
stats: Consumes 5 Charges from your Mana Flask
description: Consume charges from your Mana Flask to throw a flask that explodes, dealing Physical Attack damage in an area. The thrown flask Consumes Poison on Hit to cause an acidic burst.
skillStats: Consumes 5 Charges from your Mana Flask

beginner.whatItIs: A thrown flask that drains five charges from your mana flask and bursts on impact for physical attack damage, eating any poison already on the enemies it hits to add an acid detonation.
beginner.whyItMatters: It gives you a real damage skill that runs on flask charges rather than a weapon, so an unarmed or off-weapon character still has a way to clear packs.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Throw it into groups you have already poisoned so the acid burst has something to consume. Keep a source of flask charge generation running or you will fire two throws and go dry.

name: Alchemist's Boon
stats: (15-34)% of recovery from your Flasks is also granted to Allies in your Presence
Grants you (0.17-0.23) Flask charges per second
description: While active, grants you Flask charges passively and causes Life and Mana recovery from your Flasks to also apply to Allies in your Presence.
skillStats: (15-34)% of recovery from your Flasks is also granted to Allies in your Presence
Grants you (0.17-0.23) Flask charges per second

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent aura that trickles flask charges to you over time and shares part of your flask healing with allies standing near you.
beginner.whyItMatters: Flask charges are the limiting factor on every flask-driven skill and on your own healing, so a steady trickle keeps you topped up between packs instead of hunting for kills to refill.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Run it in a party, or on any character built around throwing flasks, where the passive charge drip funds a skill you would otherwise be unable to keep using.

name: Align Fate
stats: Modifiers to Cooldown Recovery Rate also apply to Visage appearance frequency
25% more Visage frequency per Spell Visages could cast
Casting the matching Spell before the next
description: While active, visages of yourself from alternate timelines will occasionally appear and cast one of your Spells from your first valid Weapon Set. Until the next visage appears, your next cast of the same Spell aligns your fate, Empowering that Spell. Visages can only cast damaging, non-Channelling, non-Buff Spells you could cast that have no cooldown.
skillStats: Modifiers to Cooldown Recovery Rate also apply to Visage appearance frequency
25% more Visage frequency per Spell Visages could cast
Casting the matching Spell before the next

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent buff that periodically makes a mirror image of you appear and cast one of your own spells. Casting that same spell yourself before the next image shows up makes your version hit noticeably harder.
beginner.whyItMatters: It rewards paying attention rather than mashing one button, handing you a large damage bonus on a spell you were going to cast anyway.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Best on a character with two or three damaging spells in rotation, where you can watch what the image casts and answer it. A one-button build gets far less out of it.

name: Ancestral Cry
stats: Generates 100% of Monster Power as Glory for this Skill on Igniting an enemy
Knocks back and interrupts enemies in a smaller area
Consumes all Endurance Charges to increase Warcry duration by 50% per charge
Converts 100% of Physical Damage to Fire damage with Boosted Attacks

skillStats: Generates 100% of Monster Power as Glory for this Skill on Igniting an enemy

beginner.whatItIs: A shout you can only use after setting enough enemies on fire, which transforms you for eight seconds so that moving leaves burning footprints and your melee hits set off eruptions.
beginner.whyItMatters: It converts the ignites you were already applying into a burst window, so a fire melee character gets a big periodic power spike instead of steady sameness.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Save it for a boss or a dense pack, and spend your endurance charges first since the shout eats them to run longer. It needs a melee weapon in hand.

name: Ancestral Spirits
stats: Minions from this skill have 1% increased Attack Speed per 3 of your Dexterity
Modifiers to Totem Life also affects Minions from this Skill
Minions from this skill have 1% increased Damage per 1 of your Strength

beginner.whatItIs: A minion skill you never press. Every time you place a totem it also summons a spirit fighter, which dies with the totem that spawned it.
beginner.whyItMatters: It doubles the value of every totem you drop, and its spirits scale off your own Strength and Dexterity rather than needing separate minion gear.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Take it on any build that already spams totems. It does nothing at all on a character with no totem skill.

name: Ancestral Warrior Totem
stats: Totem gains +(0-75)% to all Elemental Resistances
Cannot have more than 10 Ancestral Warrior Totems active
description: Consume 3 Endurance Charges to Raise a Totem that uses socketed Mace Skills. Cannot use Channelling Skills or Skills with Cooldowns.
skillStats: Totem gains +(0-75)% to all Elemental Resistances
Cannot have more than 10 Ancestral Warrior Totems active

beginner.whatItIs: A support-style gem that eats three Endurance Charges to plant a totem which repeats whatever mace skill you socket into it.
beginner.whyItMatters: It lets a slow, heavy mace skill be delivered by something that cannot be interrupted or killed easily, so you keep attacking while you reposition.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Drop the totem before a boss commits to an attack, then dodge freely while it swings for you. It refuses channelled skills and anything with a cooldown.

name: Animus Exchange
stats: Gain Runic Ward equal to 70% of Sacrificed Life
description: Sacrifice a portion of your Life to recover Runic Ward. Runic Ward recovered by this Skill can Overflow.
skillStats: Gain Runic Ward equal to 70% of Sacrificed Life

beginner.whatItIs: A spell that cuts into your own life pool and converts most of what you gave up into Runic Ward, a shield that can be stacked past its normal ceiling by this skill.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is the trade that makes Runic Ward builds work, letting you bank a large protective buffer on demand instead of waiting for it to build.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Cast it when your life is high and there is a lull, so you enter the next fight with a full ward. Never cast it while already low.

name: Animus Splinters
stats: This Skill's Base Cost is equal to (153-200)% of the Base Costs of Socketed Skills
Gains 100% of Life and Mana Cost as Extra Runic Ward Cost
description: Expend a large amount of Runic Ward to instantly create a short-lived copy of yourself that uses a Socketed Skill once, then vanishes. This Skill's cost is equal to the total cost of Socketed Skills. The copy cannot perform Channelled, Remote, Cooldown or Conditional Skills, or summon Minions.
skillStats: This Skill's Base Cost is equal to (153-200)% of the Base Costs of Socketed Skills
Gains 100% of Life and Mana Cost as Extra Runic Ward Cost

beginner.whatItIs: A meta gem that spends a large amount of Runic Ward to spawn a brief copy of you, which fires the socketed skill once and disappears.
beginner.whyItMatters: It turns stored ward into an extra activation of your strongest skill, which is a way to break the normal cast-speed ceiling on a big slow ability.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it on a boss for an extra hit of your heaviest spell. It cannot copy channelled, cooldown or minion skills, so check the socketed skill first.

name: Apocalypse
stats: Duration of the Apocalypse is 12 seconds
Triggers one of three disasters every 0.75 seconds
description: Build Glory by Hitting enemies with Elemental damage. When you have maximum Glory, you may become the walking Apocalypse for a duration, Triggering one of multiple powerful Elemental Skills at an interval while this Buff lasts.
skillStats: Duration of the Apocalypse is 12 seconds
Triggers one of three disasters every 0.75 seconds

beginner.whatItIs: A meter you fill by hitting enemies with elemental damage. Once it is full you can spend it to spend twelve seconds firing off a random heavy elemental effect roughly every three quarters of a second.
beginner.whyItMatters: It gives elemental characters a stored burst window, so damage you did on trash mobs is banked and paid out during the fight that matters.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Fill it on the way to a boss and open the fight with it. Holding it while it is already full wastes every hit you land.

name: Arc
stats: Chains 6 additional times when Lightning Infused
description: An arc of Lightning stretches from the caster to a targeted enemy and Chains on to other nearby enemies. Consumes a Lightning Infusion if possible to deal more damage and Chain further.
skillStats: Chains 6 additional times when Lightning Infused

beginner.whatItIs: A bolt of lightning that leaps from you to an enemy and then jumps on to several more nearby targets.
beginner.whyItMatters: It clears a spread-out room from one cast without needing you to aim well, which is exactly the problem most early caster skills have.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it as your main clear against loose groups. Build a source of Lightning Infusion and its damage roughly triples on the consuming cast.

name: Archmage
stats: Non-Channelling Spells Gain 4% of Damage as extra Lightning damage for each 100 maximum Mana you have
Non-Channelling Spells cost an additional (8-6.1)% of your maximum Mana
description: While active, causes your Non-Channelling Spells to cost additional mana and deal extra Lightning damage, both based on your maximum Mana.
skillStats: Non-Channelling Spells Gain 4% of Damage as extra Lightning damage for each 100 maximum Mana you have
Non-Channelling Spells cost an additional (8-6.1)% of your maximum Mana

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent buff that makes your non-channelled spells cost a slice of your maximum mana on top of their normal cost, and adds lightning damage scaled to that same maximum mana.
beginner.whyItMatters: It rewrites how a caster scales: instead of chasing spell damage on gear, you chase a big mana pool, and every point of mana becomes damage.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Turn it on once you have stacked mana on your gear and have mana regeneration or leech to pay the inflated costs. Early on it will simply leave you empty.

name: Arctic Armour
stats: Deals (3-101) to (5-152) Cold Damage per Stage
Gains a Stage every (1.25-0.72) seconds, up to a maximum of (2-5) Stages
description: While active, conjures an icy barrier that gains stages over time. While the barrier has stages, Melee Attacks that hit you will remove a stage to cause a burst of ice that deals Cold Spell damage to the attacker.
skillStats: Deals (3-101) to (5-152) Cold Damage per Stage
Gains a Stage every (1.25-0.72) seconds, up to a maximum of (2-5) Stages

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent barrier of ice that builds up layers over time. Each melee hit you take strips one layer and answers with a burst of cold damage back at the attacker.
beginner.whyItMatters: It punishes anything that walks into melee range and its cold bursts chill and freeze, so it is defence and crowd control from the same slot.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Run it on a character that expects to be surrounded. Give it a moment of quiet to stack layers before you dive into a pack.

name: Arctic Howl

If an enemy is Frozen or a Frozen enemy is Hit, this Skill Empowers your attacks with added Cold damage, causes Empowered Slams to create Chilled Ground, and grants your Allies added Cold damage. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge.

beginner.whatItIs: A werewolf shout that damages everything around you, freezes anything already primed to freeze, and then empowers your attacks with extra cold damage for eight seconds.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is both an escape tool and a damage window, and the buff it grants also feeds allies, so it earns its place in a party.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Shout when a pack closes in to freeze and knock them back, then attack into the empowered window. Spend an endurance charge to shout again early.

name: Armour Breaker
stats: 40% more attack speed while Dual Wielding
description: Strike with a forceful blow, knocking enemies back and weakening their Armour.
skillStats: 40% more attack speed while Dual Wielding

beginner.whatItIs: A mace swing that knocks enemies backwards and strips a chunk of their armour with the hit.
beginner.whyItMatters: Broken armour means every later physical hit from you and your party lands much harder, so this is a setup tool disguised as an attack.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Open a boss fight with two or three swings to shred its armour, then switch to your damage skill. Dual wielding makes it swing far faster.

name: Armour Piercing Rounds
description: Load your Crossbow with a clip of bolts that can be fired rapidly and Break enemy Armour. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.

beginner.whatItIs: A crossbow loading skill that fills a clip with bolts you can fire off quickly, each one chipping away at enemy armour.
beginner.whyItMatters: Crossbows work on the load-then-fire rhythm, and this is the clip that softens armoured targets for whatever heavier ammunition you fire next.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Load it before a durable target, empty the clip into it, then swap to a bigger ammunition skill while the armour is down.

name: Artillery Ballista
stats: Totem gains +(0-75)% to all Elemental Resistances
description: Deploy a Ballista Totem that rains down a salvo of Pinning, Maiming bolts.
skillStats: Totem gains +(0-75)% to all Elemental Resistances

beginner.whatItIs: A crossbow totem that plants itself and rains a salvo of bolts on the area you aimed at, pinning and slowing what it hits.
beginner.whyItMatters: It keeps damage landing on a spot while you are busy moving, and the pin it applies stops runners from reaching you.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Plant it on a doorway or on a boss before you start kiting. Only one can be active at a time, so reposition it rather than spamming it.

name: Attrition
stats: You have Culling Strike against Rare and Unique enemies that have been in your Presence for a total of at least (40-31) seconds
You deal 1% more Hit damage to Rare and Unique enemies for every 2 seconds they have ever been in your Presence, up to (40-59)%
description: While active, causes you to deal more Hit damage to Rare and Unique enemies the longer you've been fighting them, and gain Culling Strike against them once you've been fighting them for long enough.
skillStats: You have Culling Strike against Rare and Unique enemies that have been in your Presence for a total of at least (40-31) seconds
You deal 1% more Hit damage to Rare and Unique enemies for every 2 seconds they have ever been in your Presence, up to (40-59)%

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent buff that grows your damage against a rare or unique enemy the longer that enemy stays near you, and eventually lets you execute it outright once it is low.
beginner.whyItMatters: Long boss fights are where most builds fall off, and this one gets stronger the longer the fight drags, which is the opposite of a burst skill.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Run it for bosses and tanky rares. It gives you nothing while clearing packs that die in a second.

name: Azmerian Swarms
stats: Summon an Azmerian Swarm when you kill a target affected by an Elemental Ailment
10% chance to summon an Azmerian Swarm when you Hit a Rare or Unique target affected by an Elemental Ailment
Swarms have 100% chance to inflict 1 Faerie Fire on Hit

skillStats: Summon an Azmerian Swarm when you kill a target affected by an Elemental Ailment

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent skill that spawns small untargetable swarms when you kill or hit enemies already suffering a burn, chill or shock. The swarms chase and attack on their own.
beginner.whyItMatters: It converts ailments you were applying anyway into free extra damage, and the swarms cannot be killed by the enemy, so the value is never lost.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pair it with any elemental build that reliably ignites, chills or shocks. It is dead weight on a pure physical character.

name: Ball Lightning
stats: Hits enemies in range every 0.2 seconds
description: Fire a slow-moving Projectile that moves through enemies. The Projectile itself does not Hit enemies, but repeatedly discharges bolts of Lightning at nearby enemies. Consumes a Fire Infusion if possible to slow down over time, create Ignited Ground as it travels, and explode dealing Fire damage in an Area after it dissipates.
skillStats: Hits enemies in range every 0.2 seconds

beginner.whatItIs: A slow orb that drifts through enemies without hitting them directly, zapping everything near it every fraction of a second as it travels.
beginner.whyItMatters: Because it fires so many small hits, it applies shock and stacks up hit-count effects far faster than a skill that lands one big blow.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Fire it through a packed corridor and let it grind. Give it a Fire Infusion to have it slow down, leave burning ground and detonate at the end.

name: Barkskin
stats: When Hit by an enemy, gain Armour equal to (43-62)% of Energy Shield lost
description: While active, taking Hit damage from enemies to your Energy Shield causes you to gain Armour for a short duration. Armour gained from multiple Hits can stack. The total Armour gained from this Skill cannot exceed the Item Armour on your Equipped Armour Items.
skillStats: When Hit by an enemy, gain Armour equal to (43-62)% of Energy Shield lost

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent skill that converts energy shield you lose to enemy hits into temporary armour, up to the total armour printed on the gear you are wearing.
beginner.whyItMatters: It patches the classic energy shield weakness: after the shield pops you are soft, and this hands you physical mitigation exactly when it happens.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Run it on a hybrid energy shield and armour character. It does nothing if your gear carries no armour value for it to copy.

name: Barrage
stats: Empowered Attacks Repeat +2 times, and a further +1 time per Frenzy Charge consumed
(600-410)% of Empowered Skill's attack time is added to this skill's cooldown, to a maximum of 30 seconds
description: Ready a volley of arrows or spears, Empowering your next Repeatable Bow or Projectile Spear Attack to Repeat multiple times. Consumes your Frenzy Charges on use to add additional repeats.
skillStats: Empowered Attacks Repeat +2 times, and a further +1 time per Frenzy Charge consumed
(600-410)% of Empowered Skill's attack time is added to this skill's cooldown, to a maximum of 30 seconds

beginner.whatItIs: A short buff that makes your next bow or spear attack fire several extra times, with each of your Frenzy Charges buying another repeat.
beginner.whyItMatters: It compresses many attacks into one press, which is how a bow or spear build lands a large burst on a boss between dodges.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Charge it, then immediately fire your main attack. The cooldown scales with how slow the attack you empowered is, so it fits a heavy shot better than a fast one.

name: Barrier Invocation
stats: When Hit by an Enemy, gain 1 Energy for each 10 Energy Shield lost to damage taken
description: While active, gains Energy when your Energy Shield is damaged by Enemy Hits. Using the Invocation once sufficient Energy is gathered will consume the Energy to trigger socketed Spells, and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough Energy.
skillStats: When Hit by an Enemy, gain 1 Energy for each 10 Energy Shield lost to damage taken

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent meta gem that stores energy every time an enemy hit chews through your energy shield, and holds that energy until you choose to spend it on the socketed spells.
beginner.whyItMatters: Unlike an automatic trigger, you decide the moment it fires, so a fight where you took a lot of chip damage pays out exactly when you need the burst.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it on an energy shield character that expects to be hit often. Bank the charge through a trash pack and release it on the boss.

name: Berserk
stats: Lose 0.1% of maximum Life per Rage per second while not losing Rage
description: While active, strengthens your Rage, but causes you to lose Life while not losing Rage.
skillStats: Lose 0.1% of maximum Life per Rage per second while not losing Rage

beginner.whatItIs: A toggle that makes your Rage far more potent while draining your life for every point of Rage you are holding.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is a deliberate gamble: enormous damage as long as you keep killing and keep your healing ahead of the drain.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Flick it on for the dangerous part of a fight and off again. Do not leave it running while you walk around at low life.

name: Bind Spectre
description: Capture the spirit of a defeated monster, transforming this gem to instead allow you to summon the monster's ghost as a Reviving Minion.

beginner.whatItIs: A capture skill used on a dead monster. Once it takes a spirit, the gem itself changes into a summon for that specific monster's ghost.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is the one skill that lets you turn a monster you liked fighting into a permanent servant, so your minion army is chosen rather than fixed.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Capture something with a useful attack, not just something that hit hard. Rebind it whenever you find a stronger monster of the same type.

name: Black Powder Blitz
description: Replaces your dodge roll with an explosive-assisted leap, firing off a round from your prosthetic cannon leg that Blinds and Ignites enemies in the area you escape from. The explosion will cause any Grenades in its area of effect to also explode.

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent skill that swaps your dodge roll for an explosive hop, blasting the spot you just left with a shot that blinds and ignites, and setting off any grenades in range.
beginner.whyItMatters: It makes the movement you already spam into damage and a detonator, which is a large amount of value from a button you press constantly.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Take it on a grenade build so your escapes double as the detonation. Roll out through the pack rather than away from it.

name: Blasphemy
stats: Socketed Curse Skills apply in an Aura around you
description: Turn socketed Curse skills into vile Auras, applying their effects to all nearby enemies.
skillStats: Socketed Curse Skills apply in an Aura around you

beginner.whatItIs: A meta gem that stops your socketed curses being cast at a target and instead broadcasts them permanently to everything near you.
beginner.whyItMatters: Curses are strong but casting them costs time you would rather spend attacking; this makes them automatic at the price of reserved spirit.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it once you have enough spirit to spare, since each socketed curse eats sixty. One curse and a full spirit pool is usually better than two and no room.

name: Bleeding Concoction
stats: Consumes 5 Charges from your Mana Flask
description: Consume charges from your Mana Flask to throw a flask that explodes, dealing Physical Attack damage in an area and Aggravating Bleeding on Enemies hit. This damage is not based on your unarmed damage, so this is not considered an Unarmed Attack
skillStats: Consumes 5 Charges from your Mana Flask

beginner.whatItIs: A thrown mana flask that bursts for physical damage, opens bleeding wounds on everything it hits, and worsens bleeding that is already there.
beginner.whyItMatters: Aggravated bleeding keeps ticking at full rate even on a standing enemy, which is what makes bleed viable against bosses rather than just runners.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Throw it after your bleed has been applied by another hit so it has something to worsen. It runs on flask charges, not on your weapon.

name: Blink
stats: Must be active in both Weapon Sets
description: While active, replaces your dodge roll with a short-cooldown Spell that allows you to tunnel through space, instantly reappearing a medium distance away.
skillStats: Must be active in both Weapon Sets

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent skill that replaces your dodge roll with a short teleport on a brief cooldown.
beginner.whyItMatters: A teleport skips everything between you and where you land, so it beats a roll for getting out of a slam or through a wall of enemies.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Take it on a caster that has no other escape. Watch the cooldown, because unlike a roll it is not always available.

name: Blood Boil

Blood Boil applies to non-Unique enemies in your Presence every (2-1.52) seconds

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent skill that quietly grows blood blisters on enemies standing near you. When one of them dies, the blisters burst and spread a bleeding poison to everything around the corpse.
beginner.whyItMatters: It turns the first kill in a pack into a chain reaction, so you clear groups without ever aiming a second skill at them.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Let it tick for a moment while you fight the edge of a pack, then kill something in the middle. It only marks non-unique enemies.

beginner.whatItIs: A spear lunge that skewers a target, and detonates the wound if the enemy has already lost enough blood, consuming their bleeding to do it.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is the payoff half of a bleed build, cashing in damage over time you already applied for one large instant explosion.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Apply bleeding first with another spear skill, wait a beat for the blood loss to build, then lunge. Used cold it is a weak poke.

beginner.whyItMatters: Enemy chaos resistance is what blunts a poison or chaos build, and removing thirty five to forty nine percent of it is usually the single biggest damage gain available.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Cast it before your damage skill on any pack or boss you intend to poison. It refuses to stick to enemies well above the gem's own level.

beginner.whyItMatters: Because part of the damage scales off the corpse rather than your gear, a room full of tough dead monsters becomes a room full of bombs.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Kill one enemy in a pack, then detonate it into the rest. It is useless as an opener with nothing on the ground.

beginner.whatItIs: A bow attack you hold to charge up. At full charge the arrow leaves a large fire explosion where its flight ends.
beginner.whyItMatters: Charging multiplies its fire damage several times over, so the difference between a tapped shot and a full one is enormous.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Take the time to reach four stages before releasing, which means using it when you have space rather than mid-scramble.

beginner.whyItMatters: It is healing, charge generation and area damage in a single press, all funded by the mess you already made.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it after a pack dies, targeting a distant corpse so you get the leap and the slam as well as the meal.

beginner.whyItMatters: Flat energy shield is multiplied by every percentage increase on your gear, so this is one of the most efficient defensive reservations a caster has.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Run it permanently on any energy shield character once you have the spirit to reserve. It does very little on a life-based build with no shield to scale.

skillStats: Grants (1-3) Frenzy Charges on Parried Consumption

beginner.whatItIs: A spear skill that jumps you backwards while erupting spearpoints in front of you, and grants Frenzy Charges if the enemies you hit were already parried.
beginner.whyItMatters: You cannot be hit by strikes or projectiles during the jump, so it is a defensive reset that pays you charges for using it correctly.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Parry first, then disengage into the parried enemies for the charges. It can be used to cancel another skill you are already committed to.

beginner.whatItIs: A banner earned by attacking that, once planted, raises your and your allies' maximum elemental resistances, makes you far harder to freeze, shock or ignite, and refills flask charges.
beginner.whyItMatters: Maximum resistance is the hardest defensive statistic to raise anywhere else, so a few extra points here is worth more than it looks.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Plant it before an elemental boss phase or a heavy ailment pack, and stay inside its radius.

100% increased Magnitude of Jagged Ground you create
While Dual Wielding, both weapons hit with 30% less damage

beginner.whatItIs: A mace slam that damages the area, leaves broken ground that slows enemies, and then erupts that ground in a much larger aftershock a moment later.
beginner.whyItMatters: The aftershock carries the bulk of the damage, so the slow left by the first hit is what keeps enemies standing in it.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Slam into a group and then let the aftershock land instead of moving them elsewhere. You can only keep a few patches of broken ground at once.

name: Earthshatter

Deals damage along the fissure's path and in a 1 metre radius around the emerging spike

beginner.whatItIs: A mace slam that sends a crack racing along the ground and plants a spike where it ends. Shouting near the spike shatters it for damage all around.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is built to be combined: alone it is a line of moderate damage, but with a warcry it becomes a set of remote-detonated bombs.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Plant several spikes around a boss, then use any warcry to set them off together. Up to six can be waiting at once.

name: Electrocuting Arrow
stats: Converts 80% of Physical damage to Lightning damage
description: Fire an electrifying arrow that explodes in an Area on Hit. Hitting an enemy will attach an Electrocuting Rod to them, causing all incoming Lightning damage to build up Electrocution. This rod is removed when the enemy is next Electrocuted.
skillStats: Converts 80% of Physical damage to Lightning damage

beginner.whatItIs: A bow shot that explodes on impact and sticks a rod into the target, so that every scrap of lightning damage that target takes builds towards being electrocuted.
beginner.whyItMatters: Electrocution is difficult to reach on a tough enemy, and this makes all of your lightning damage count towards it instead of only the big hits.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Tag a boss with it first, then unload your fast lightning skill. The rod is removed once the electrocution lands, so it needs re-applying.

name: Elemental Conflux
stats: Buff grants (40-59)% more damage with the affected Element

skillStats: Buff grants (40-59)% more damage with the affected Element

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent buff that greatly increases your damage of one random element at a time, rerolling which element every eight seconds.
beginner.whyItMatters: If you deal all three elements roughly evenly, this is a large average damage increase for a single gem slot.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Run it only on a build that deals fire, cold and lightning together. On a single-element character it is idle two thirds of the time.

name: Elemental Expression
stats: Triggers Fiery Explosion, Arcing Bolt, or Icy Wave on Melee Critical Hit
description: Create a fiery explosion, an arcing bolt of lightning, or an icy wave of projectiles. The chance for an explosion is proportional to your Strength, for a bolt proportional to your Dexterity, and for a wave proportional to your Intelligence.
skillStats: Triggers Fiery Explosion, Arcing Bolt, or Icy Wave on Melee Critical Hit

beginner.whatItIs: A skill that fires itself on your melee critical hits, producing a fire blast, a lightning bolt or a spray of ice, with the odds set by your Strength, Dexterity and Intelligence.
beginner.whyItMatters: It rewards an attribute-stacking character with free spell damage, and which effect you get is something your gear choices actually control.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Take it on a melee build with a good critical chance. Push one attribute hard if you want a consistent effect rather than a lottery.

name: Elemental Invocation

skillStats: Gains 10 Energy per Power of enemies you Freeze with Hits from Skills

Gains 1 Energy per Power of enemies you Shock with Hits from Skills

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent meta gem that stores energy each time you freeze, shock or ignite something and holds it until you press the invocation to fire the socketed spells, possibly several times over.
beginner.whyItMatters: Holding the charge yourself means you can dump a whole fight's worth of stored spells into one boss window instead of leaking them onto trash.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Charge it through a map and release on the target that matters. Freezing fills it far faster than igniting does.

name: Elemental Storm

skillStats: Enemies inside the storm are Hindered

beginner.whatItIs: A skill triggered by your elemental hits that plants a stationary storm of fire, cold or lightning, matching whichever element hit hardest.
beginner.whyItMatters: It adds a lingering area of damage that also hinders everything standing in it, without you spending a press or a targeting decision.
beginner.whenToUseIt: It suits a build that hits a stationary target repeatedly, since the storm does not follow. A hit that deals no elemental damage will never start one.

name: Elemental Sundering
description: Plunge your Spear into the ground to emit a pulse that Consumes Freeze, Shock and Ignite on a number of nearby enemies, Allies and Corpses. The pulse itself deals no damage, but each Ailment Consumed causes an explosion of the corresponding elemental damage type.

beginner.whatItIs: A spear skill that sends out a wide pulse dealing no damage of its own, but stripping freeze, shock and ignite off up to twenty nearby enemies, allies and corpses and detonating each one for its element.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is a mass payoff button: the more ailments you scattered beforehand, the larger the explosion, which is how an elemental spear build clears a screen.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Apply ailments broadly first, then pulse. Used on an unaffected pack it literally does nothing.

name: Elemental Surge

beginner.whatItIs: A skill that charges your weapon so that non-melee projectile attacks spend the charge to make each projectile detonate in fire, cold or lightning at the end of its flight.
beginner.whyItMatters: It bolts an elemental area explosion onto a single-target projectile skill and converts its physical damage across, which is a large clear upgrade.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Take it on a ranged physical build that lacks area coverage. It cannot consume charges, so it does not compete with your charge skills.

beginner.whyItMatters: Every elemental build eventually runs into resistant enemies, and stripping up to fifty nine percent of their resistance is usually a bigger gain than any gear upgrade.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Cast it on a boss or a tough pack before your damage. It will not stick to enemies far above the gem's level, so keep the gem levelled.

name: Ember Fusillade

Recasting this spell resets the duration for all active Embers. Multiple Embers fired in the same Fusillade will attempt to target different enemies. Consumes a Lightning Infusion if possible to cause the entire Fusillade to create beams that Chain to enemies.
skillStats: 5% more Damage for each previous Ember fired in sequence

beginner.whyItMatters: Because embers stack up and each one fired in a sequence hits harder than the last, holding a full set and releasing them together is a real burst.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Stack embers while moving, then stop casting so they all fire. Give it a Lightning Infusion and the whole volley turns into chaining beams.

beginner.whatItIs: A crossbow skill that instantly refills every ammunition clip you have and makes the reloaded bolts hit noticeably harder for a few seconds.
beginner.whyItMatters: Running dry mid-fight is the crossbow's structural weakness, and this removes the reload animation exactly when it would have killed you.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Press it the moment a clip empties during a boss window, not to top up a half-full clip, since the empowered bolts are what you are paying for.

beginner.whatItIs: A spell that spends every stack of Jade you have accumulated to wrap yourself in Guard worth six percent of your maximum life per stack.
beginner.whyItMatters: Guard soaks damage before your life pool does, so this is a large on-demand buffer for a character who has been building Jade passively.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Cast it just before a big hit lands rather than after. You cannot gain more Jade while the Guard is up, so do not refresh it early.

Enemies Hit receive Electrocution buildup from Lightning damage for 4 second duration

beginner.whatItIs: A ring of lightning that expands around you. Enemies right next to you take nothing while enemies at the outer edge take far more, and everything hit becomes vulnerable to electrocution for a few seconds.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is the setup for an electrocution build, since it makes all your lightning damage count towards electrocuting the targets it touched.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Cast it at the range where the ring's edge lands on the pack, not with the pack in your face. Follow up immediately while the vulnerability lasts.

name: Enfeeble

skillStats: Curse makes targets deal (20-29)% less Damage

beginner.whatItIs: A curse laid over an area after a short delay that makes everything inside it deal noticeably less damage.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is a defensive layer that works on damage types resistances cannot touch, which is why it survives into the hardest content.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Cast it on the pack that is about to hit you, especially rare enemies with large hits. It will not apply to enemies far above the gem's level.

name: Entangle
stats: Attaches Vines to enemies within 1.5 metres
description: Conjures a rootbound fissure that crawls forward, damaging enemies in its path. While the fissure persists, vines lash out from it and attach to nearby enemies, damaging and Slowing them.
skillStats: Attaches Vines to enemies within 1.5 metres

beginner.whatItIs: A crawling fissure of roots that damages enemies in its path and then keeps lashing vines at nearby targets to damage and slow them for as long as it lasts.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is area damage that stays where you put it and slows what it touches, which turns a corridor into a place enemies cannot cross quickly.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Fire it along the line enemies are approaching from. You can keep several fissures running, so layering them across a doorway is the strongest use.

name: Escape Shot
stats: Converts 80% of Physical damage to Cold damage
description: Leap backwards, firing an icy arrow which can Chill or Freeze enemies around the location from which you escaped. This arrow will create Ice Fragments on impact.
skillStats: Converts 80% of Physical damage to Cold damage

beginner.whatItIs: A bow skill that hops you backwards while firing an icy arrow into the spot you left, chilling or freezing enemies there and scattering ice fragments.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is a disengage that punishes whatever chased you, and the fragments it leaves are ammunition for other cold skills that detonate them.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it as your panic button when melee closes in. Its projectile count cannot be changed, so support gems that add arrows do nothing for it.

name: Essence Drain

beginner.whatItIs: A chaos projectile that lands a modest hit and leaves behind a powerful wasting effect that keeps damaging the target for several seconds.
beginner.whyItMatters: Almost all of its damage is in the lingering effect, and that effect scales with spell damage, so it is the backbone of a chaos over-time build.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Apply it and move on rather than standing still recasting. Pair it with a spreading skill so one application covers a whole pack.

name: Eternal March
stats: Spends up to (19-853) Runic Ward to Revive Minions with total maximum Life equal to (3-20) times the Runic Ward spent

beginner.whatItIs: A spell that spends your stored Runic Ward to bring your dead minions back instantly, starting with the strongest.
beginner.whyItMatters: A summoner who loses the army loses all its damage, and this restores it in one press instead of a long re-summoning sequence.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Press it straight after a boss wipes your minions, provided you have banked ward. Every point of ward revives many times its value in minion life.

name: Eternal Rage
stats: Must be active in both Weapon Sets
description: While active, you constantly regenerate Rage.
skillStats: Must be active in both Weapon Sets

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent buff that trickles Rage onto you every second for as long as it stays on, up to 5 Rage per second at high gem levels.
beginner.whyItMatters: Rage normally has to be earned by hitting things, so a warrior who wants its damage bonus spends the opening seconds of every fight building it up. This removes that ramp.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Run it on a Rage-spending build once you can pay its reservation. It has to be socketed in both weapon sets to keep working when you swap.

name: Explosive Concoction
stats: Consumes 5 Charges from your Mana Flask
description: Consume charges from your Mana Flask to throw a flask that explodes, dealing Fire Attack damage in an area. Additional smaller flasks are thrown at nearby Ignited Enemies.
skillStats: Consumes 5 Charges from your Mana Flask

beginner.whatItIs: A thrown flask that spends 5 charges from your mana flask and bursts into fire damage in an area, with extra small flasks raining on any burning enemies nearby.
beginner.whyItMatters: It gives you real area damage with no weapon requirement at all, because the flask is the weapon, which is why it carries early characters who have not found a good base yet.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Throw it into packs, and lead with something that ignites so the bonus flasks have targets. Watch your mana flask charges, since the skill stops working when they run dry.

name: Explosive Grenade
stats: Converts 80% of Physical damage to Fire damage
Consumes 15 Heat if possible to Gain 50% of damage as Fire damage
description: Fire a bouncing Grenade that unleashes a devastating fiery blast when its fuse expires.
skillStats: Converts 80% of Physical damage to Fire damage
Consumes 15 Heat if possible to Gain 50% of damage as Fire damage

beginner.whatItIs: A crossbow skill that lobs a bouncing grenade with a 3 second fuse, which then detonates for a large mostly-fire blast.
beginner.whyItMatters: The fuse is the whole point: the damage is high because you have to plan three seconds ahead, and any detonator skill can set it off early.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bounce it into a pack you are kiting, or drop several and pop them together with a detonator. It is poor against something already swinging at you, since the fuse will not have run.

name: Explosive Shot
description: Load your Crossbow with flaming bolts that explode on impact. The explosion will cause any Grenades in its area of effect to also explode.

beginner.whatItIs: A crossbow reload skill that fills the clip with bolts that explode where they land, and those explosions also set off any grenades caught in the blast.
beginner.whyItMatters: It turns a single-target crossbow into a pack clearer, and it is a clean way to trigger a pile of grenades from a safe distance.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Load it when you are about to hit a group rather than a boss, since it costs 30% reload speed for the privilege. Pair it with any grenade skill and use it as the detonator.

name: Explosive Spear
stats: Converts 60% of Physical damage to Fire damage
description: Hurl a single payload Spear that pierces through enemies and lodges in terrain where it lands. The Spear will explode at the end of its Detonation Time or if Detonated. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if you have one to explode immediately, dealing more damage in a cross-shaped area and creating Ignited Ground.
skillStats: Converts 60% of Physical damage to Fire damage

beginner.whatItIs: A thrown spear that pierces everything, sticks into the ground, and blows up when its 2.5 second fuse ends or when something detonates it early.
beginner.whyItMatters: You can plant up to three of them and set them off at once, which turns a spear build into a trap layer rather than a poker.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Plant them along the path a boss or a pack will walk down. If you are holding a Frenzy Charge you can spend it to detonate instantly in a cross shape and leave burning ground.

name: Eye of Winter
stats: Gains 100% of damage as damage of the corresponding Type when passing over an Elemental Ground Effect or Orb
Each use of this Skill deals 900% more damage with its first Hit against each enemy
description: Fire a single Eye Projectile which does not Hit enemies. The Eye constantly releases damaging shard Projectiles in a spiral as it flies. If the Eye passes over an Elemental Ground Surface or Orb, it will take on that surface's effect causing shards to deal more damage of the corresponding Type.
skillStats: Gains 100% of damage as damage of the corresponding Type when passing over an Elemental Ground Effect or Orb
Each use of this Skill deals 900% more damage with its first Hit against each enemy

beginner.whatItIs: A slow cold projectile that never hits anything itself, and instead spits 30 small shards per second in a spiral while it travels.
beginner.whyItMatters: All the damage comes from the shards, so it hurts most when the eye is drifting through a crowd rather than past a single target.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Fire it through a group and let it grind. If you leave elemental ground or an orb in its path it picks up that element and the shards hit harder.

name: Falling Thunder
stats: Converts 60% of Physical damage to Lightning damage
description: Suffuse your Quarterstaff with electrical energy, then Slam the ground to deal damage in a large cone in front of you. Consumes your Power Charges to fire Lightning Projectiles forwards from the impact.
skillStats: Converts 60% of Physical damage to Lightning damage

beginner.whatItIs: A quarterstaff slam that hits a wide cone in front of you and converts most of its physical damage to lightning.
beginner.whyItMatters: It spends your Power Charges to fire lightning projectiles out of the impact, so charges you were saving turn into ranged damage on a melee skill.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it as your opener against a line of enemies, ideally with charges banked. Against a lone target the cone and the projectiles are mostly wasted.

name: Fangs of Frost
stats: Converts 80% of Physical damage to Cold damage
description: Perform an icy stab that exploits enemies who are already off balance. Hitting a Parried target Consumes the Debuff to cause an explosion of frost and leave Chilled Ground.
skillStats: Converts 80% of Physical damage to Cold damage

beginner.whatItIs: A spear stab with extra reach that converts most of its physical damage to cold, and explodes in frost if it lands on a parried enemy.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is built to punish: the parry consumption doubles as your freeze setup, since the skill also carries a large bonus to freeze buildup.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Parry first, then stab. The explosion leaves chilled ground, which slows whatever else was walking into you.

name: Feast of Flesh

description: Consume Corpses near you to recover Life and Mana over a short time per Corpse Consumed.
skillStats: Recover (21-211) Life and (21-211) Mana over 3 seconds per Corpse Consumed

beginner.whatItIs: A spell that eats up to 5 corpses around you and heals life and mana over 3 seconds for each one consumed.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is sustain that costs nothing but the bodies you already made, which matters on builds with no leech and no regeneration.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Cast it after a pack dies, not before. In a boss fight it does nothing unless the fight spawns adds you can kill for corpses.

name: Feral Invocation

beginner.whatItIs: A talisman meta gem that quietly stores Energy as you spend mana, then releases it to spawn visages that each swing your socketed shapeshifting attack once.

beginner.whenToUseIt: Hold the invocation until Energy is high and a fight is worth it. It needs a mana-hungry build to charge at any reasonable speed.

beginner.whenToUseIt: Open a pack fight with it so the Rage and the armour break land before your big hits. Spend an Endurance Charge to skip the cooldown when you need it twice.

beginner.whenToUseIt: Slot it on a melee build that hits often and wants an elemental follow-up. It refuses anything that is not a fire spell.

beginner.whyItMatters: It is a standard early caster nuke: enough damage to kill a pack in one landing, cheap enough to spam while levelling.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Aim at the middle of a group so the explosion overlaps. Holding a Fire Infusion when it lands adds a ring of eight firebolts on top.

name: Firebolt

beginner.whatItIs: A quick fire projectile with a small explosion where it lands.
beginner.whyItMatters: It costs little and casts fast, so it is what a fresh intelligence character kills things with before better options unlock.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it as your filler cast at low levels and against single targets. Its blast radius is under a metre, so do not expect it to clear a crowd.

beginner.whenToUseIt: Drop it where a boss is standing or where a pack has to walk. A Fire Infusion widens the storm and speeds it up, while Cold or Lightning Infusions change what the bolts deal.

beginner.whyItMatters: Projectiles you and your allies shoot through it pick up added fire damage, so it doubles as a damage buff for a bow or wand build rather than only a barrier.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Lay it across a doorway or between you and an approaching pack, then shoot through it. A Lightning Infusion adds lightning damage to the projectiles as well.

beginner.whyItMatters: A full channel is an enormous single explosion, but it demands you stand still, so it trades safety for damage more sharply than most spells.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it on a boss you can predict, or on a pack that has to funnel to you. Cast speed also lowers its cost, which is unusual and worth building around.

beginner.whatItIs: A crossbow grenade with a short fuse that blinds everything caught in the blast and carries a huge bonus to stun buildup.
beginner.whyItMatters: Blinded enemies miss you and a stunned one stops mid-swing, so this is a defensive press disguised as an attack, not a damage skill.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Throw it when a pack has closed on you or when you need a boss to stop attacking for a moment. Its fuse is under a second, so it works at melee range.

beginner.whenToUseIt: Save it for a full screen of enemies with charges banked. Do not open a boss fight with it, since there is nothing to bounce between.

beginner.whenToUseIt: Plant it in the middle of a fight, then either recall it to keep swinging or warcry to detonate it. The cooldown does not tick while it is stuck in the ground.

beginner.whenToUseIt: Shout it before you engage so the Guard and the triggered wave are both live. Burn an Endurance Charge if you need it again before the cooldown is up.

beginner.whyItMatters: It is a payoff skill: a bolt that hits a frozen enemy eats the freeze for a shrapnel explosion, and it shatters your ice crystals for extra damage as well.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Load it after something has frozen a target or planted a crystal. Firing it into unfrozen enemies wastes most of what the gem does.

beginner.whyItMatters: It closes a loop most cold builds have to fake: the mark helps you land the freeze, and the freeze pays you back with 10 seconds of added cold damage.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Put it on the toughest thing on screen and freeze that one first. Marking a second target throws away the buff you were holding.

beginner.whyItMatters: Extra projectiles on your gear become extra repeats instead of a wider spread, so the whole salvo can land on a single target rather than scattering.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Let the Seals stack while you reposition, then dump them on a boss or a dense pack. Ice Fragments in the area get their own extra repeats and are detonated.

beginner.whyItMatters: It carries a large bonus to freeze buildup and the overlapping projectiles stack that buildup fast, so it locks single targets down cheaply at low levels.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Fire it at close range so the arc overlaps on one enemy when you want a freeze, or from further back to sweep a spread-out line.

beginner.whenToUseIt: Follow a chilling skill with it. A Cold Infusion changes it further, making each dart stick into the enemy and then explode.

beginner.whenToUseIt: Drop it between you and a charging pack, then shatter it yourself for the explosion. Breaking it too quickly with something other than your own damage cuts the damage heavily.

beginner.whyItMatters: It carries a very large chill bonus, so a single bolt travelling down a corridor slows an entire line of enemies rather than just the first one.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it to soften a group before your main damage, or as a levelling skill when you want safety over speed. Its slow travel is a real cost against fast enemies.

beginner.whatItIs: A quarterstaff skill that hops you backwards and plants an ice crystal, which explodes in frost when it is destroyed.
beginner.whyItMatters: It moves you and leaves a threat behind in one press, and it can be used while another skill is already going off.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Press it when something has closed the distance on you. Only one crystal exists at a time, and it stands for 10 seconds if nothing kills it.

beginner.whenToUseIt: Open on a pack or a boss with it, then follow with your real damage while the shock is up. It does not count as an unarmed attack, so unarmed bonuses do nothing for it.

beginner.whenToUseIt: Run it when you already have a reliable way to shock a whole group. Without a shock source it does literally nothing.

beginner.whenToUseIt: Hold it down while a pack walks into the arc. Attack speed makes it cost more as well as go faster, so watch your resources.

beginner.whenToUseIt: Shock the enemy standing in the middle of a group so the orb has plenty to chain into, then move on and let it work.

When Hit, lose a Ghost Shroud
Regenerate Energy Shield equal to 2% of your Evasion Rating per second if you have lost a Ghost Shroud Recently

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent buff that hands you a Ghost Shroud every ten to twelve seconds, up to three. Being hit spends one and starts energy shield regeneration worth 2% of your evasion rating per second.
beginner.whyItMatters: It turns evasion, which normally does nothing once a hit lands, into a recovery stat, so a dodge-focused character stops being helpless after the first hit.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Take it on any character stacking evasion rating alongside energy shield. It gives nothing back to an armour build with low evasion.

name: Glacial Bolt
description: Load your Crossbow with icy bolts that create two walls of Ice Crystals at the end of their flight.

beginner.whatItIs: A crossbow ammunition skill loading icy bolts that raise two walls of ice crystals where they land.
beginner.whyItMatters: The walls are physical obstacles, so it does crowd control and area denial rather than raw damage.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Fire it across a corridor to cut a pack in half, or in front of a charging enemy to stall it. Other cold skills that shatter crystals get a second use out of the walls.

name: Glacial Cascade
stats: Converts 80% of Physical damage to Cold damage
description: Sweep your Quarterstaff upwards, releasing an icy fissure which deals damage in a series of bursts culminating in a large spike. Frozen enemies hit by the final spike are dealt heavy damage but the Freeze is Consumed. Ice Crystals hit by the final spike explode.
skillStats: Converts 80% of Physical damage to Cold damage

beginner.whatItIs: A quarterstaff sweep that sends an icy fissure 4.8 metres forward in eight bursts, finishing with a large spike.
beginner.whyItMatters: The final spike hits frozen enemies hard but eats the freeze doing it, which is a real trade rather than free damage.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it as the payoff after you have frozen a group with something else. It also detonates ice crystals, so it pairs with skills that leave them behind.

name: Glacial Lance
stats: Converts 80% of Physical damage to Cold damage
description: Throw a single Piercing lance that leaves icy fragments in its wake. The fragments Chill nearby enemies. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if possible to cause the glacial fragments created by the first Projectile to explode outwards after a short duration, peppering enemies with shrapnel.
skillStats: Converts 80% of Physical damage to Cold damage

beginner.whatItIs: A thrown spear that pierces everything and drops icy fragments behind it, which chill enemies within 1.2 metres for six seconds.
beginner.whyItMatters: The trail keeps chilling long after the throw, so a single cast slows a lane for you to fight in.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Throw it down a line of enemies rather than at one. Spend a Frenzy Charge to make the first throw's fragments burst outward for extra damage.

name: Grim Feast
stats: Remnants store 35% of Minion maximum Life
You can store up to (47-66124) collected Minion Life
description: While active, your Reviving Minions store a percentage of their maximum Life in a collectible Grim Remnant on death. Using Grim Resurrection Consumes the Life you've collected to Revive up to that much total Life of dead Minions.
skillStats: Remnants store 35% of Minion maximum Life
You can store up to (47-66124) collected Minion Life

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent minion buff. Reviving minions that die leave a Grim Remnant holding 35% of their maximum life, and Grim Resurrection spends the collected life to bring dead minions back.
beginner.whyItMatters: It turns minion deaths from pure loss into stored resurrection fuel, so a summoner recovers a wiped army without waiting on revive timers.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Run it on any build with reviving minions that die often. Remnants last only eight seconds, so you need to be near the fight to collect them.

name: Hailstorm Rounds
description: Passively generate bolts of ice at a frequency equal to reload time, up to a cap. Activate to Load the accumulated bolts into your Crossbow. All loaded bolts are fired at once, causing them to rain down over the target area.

beginner.whatItIs: A crossbow skill that quietly builds ice bolts in the background, up to fifty, then fires the whole stockpile at once so they rain over the target area.
beginner.whyItMatters: The generation happens whether you are shooting or not, so time spent walking between packs turns into a saved burst.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Hold it for a boss or a dense group and let the counter climb while you clear with something else. Firing it half-charged wastes most of its value.

name: Hammer of the Gods
stats: Generates 100% of Monster Power as Glory for this Skill on Heavy Stunning an enemy
While Dual Wielding, both weapons hit with 30% less damage
description: Build Glory by Heavy Stunning enemies. When you have maximum Glory you may entreat the Ancestors to crush your enemies, manifesting a massive hammer that falls from the sky onto your target, Slamming into the ground after a short duration and dealing immense damage based on your weapon.
skillStats: Generates 100% of Monster Power as Glory for this Skill on Heavy Stunning an enemy
While Dual Wielding, both weapons hit with 30% less damage

beginner.whatItIs: A mace slam gated behind 20 Glory, which you earn by heavy stunning enemies. It drops a huge hammer from the sky that lands 2.5 seconds later for enormous weapon damage in a 2.4 metre area.
beginner.whyItMatters: It converts stun pressure, which a mace build generates anyway, into a single very large hit that cannot be evaded.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Save it for a boss or a rare, and place it early because the hammer takes 2.5 seconds to fall. Dual wielding costs you 30% damage on both weapons.

name: Hand of Chayula
stats: Converts 73% of Physical damage to Chaos damage
description: Dash to an enemy and Strike them, triggering socketed Marks with increased effect and applying socketed Curses with increased duration.
skillStats: Converts 73% of Physical damage to Chaos damage

beginner.whatItIs: A meta gem that dashes you to an enemy and strikes with a quarterstaff, triggering marks socketed in it with more effect and applying socketed curses for twice as long.
beginner.whyItMatters: It welds your curse and mark application onto an attack you were making anyway, so you stop spending a separate button on setup.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Socket a mark or curse in it and open every fight with the dash. The strike cannot be evaded, so the setup lands even against high evasion targets.

name: Harbinger of Madness
stats: Unstable Apparitions spawned from slain enemies deal 8% of that enemy's Life as added unscalable Physical damage
Unstable Apparitions deal 5% more damage per Power of the enemy they're drawn from
Draws out an Unstable Apparition from Rare or Unique enemies you Hit
Draws out an Unstable Apparition from enemies you kill with Melee Hits, no more than once every 0.05 seconds
description: Draws out the latent fears of enemies you kill and Rare or Unique enemies you Hit, turning them into unstable apparitions which charge towards enemies and then explode.
skillStats: Unstable Apparitions spawned from slain enemies deal 8% of that enemy's Life as added unscalable Physical damage
Unstable Apparitions deal 5% more damage per Power of the enemy they're drawn from
Draws out an Unstable Apparition from Rare or Unique enemies you Hit
Draws out an Unstable Apparition from enemies you kill with Melee Hits, no more than once every 0.05 seconds

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent buff. Enemies you kill with melee hits, and rare or unique enemies you hit, release unstable apparitions that charge at other enemies and explode in a 2 metre area.
beginner.whyItMatters: It gives a melee character free chain clear, since each kill throws a bomb at whatever is next.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Take it on a melee build fighting packs. It scales off the enemy you drew it from, so it gets stronger in tougher content rather than falling off.

name: Heart of Ice
stats: Chills enemies in your Presence as though dealing (26-888) to (39-1332) Cold damage
description: Chills all enemies in your Presence.
skillStats: Chills enemies in your Presence as though dealing (26-888) to (39-1332) Cold damage

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent aura that continuously chills every enemy inside your Presence, as though it were dealing cold damage to them.
beginner.whyItMatters: Chilled enemies act more slowly, so it is defence dressed up as an aura and it costs you no button presses.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Run it on any character that wants enemies slower, and especially on a cold build, since a chill you did not have to apply is freeze buildup you did not have to spend a skill on.

name: Herald of Ash
stats: Ignite surrounding enemies if Overkill damage is at least 20% of enemy's maximum Life
description: While active, enemies you sufficiently Overkill with non-Herald Attacks will cause an explosion that Ignites nearby enemies based on the Overkill damage dealt.
skillStats: Ignite surrounding enemies if Overkill damage is at least 20% of enemy's maximum Life

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent buff. When an attack kills an enemy with at least 20% of its maximum life in overkill damage, the corpse explodes and ignites everything nearby.
beginner.whyItMatters: It rewards damage you were already wasting, turning the surplus on an overkilled enemy into clear speed on the rest of the pack.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Run it once your attack damage comfortably exceeds what trash mobs have. It does nothing on a build that kills things exactly, so it is a mid-game pickup rather than a level one.

name: Herald of Blood
stats: Deals 15% of exploded enemy's Blood Loss as unscalable Physical Attack Damage
(40-59)% chance to Aggravate Bleeding on Hit
Enemies with Blood Loss you kill explode
description: While active, killing an enemy with Blood Loss will cause a bloody explosion that deals Physical Attack damage to surrounding enemies. This damage is not based on your Weapon, but is partially based on their accumulated Blood Loss. The explosion destroys their Corpse if the enemy was Normal or Magic, and has a chance to Aggravate Bleeding.
skillStats: Deals 15% of exploded enemy's Blood Loss as unscalable Physical Attack Damage
(40-59)% chance to Aggravate Bleeding on Hit
Enemies with Blood Loss you kill explode

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent buff. Killing an enemy that is losing blood makes it burst for physical attack damage in a 1.5 metre area, based partly on how much blood loss it had built up.
beginner.whyItMatters: It gives a bleed build the pack clear it otherwise lacks, because bleeding kills one enemy at a time and this spreads that kill outward.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pair it with a skill that applies bleeding to a whole group. The explosion destroys normal and magic corpses, so avoid it if another skill of yours needs corpses.

name: Herald of Ice
description: While active, Shattering an enemy with a non-Herald Attack Hit will cause an icy explosion that deals Attack damage to surrounding enemies.

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent buff. Shattering an enemy with an attack hit causes an icy explosion that deals attack damage to everything around it.
beginner.whyItMatters: Shattering is the natural end of a freeze build, and this makes that ending clear the rest of the room for free.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Run it as soon as you can reliably freeze and shatter normal enemies. Without shatters it never triggers at all.

name: Herald of Plague
stats: Spreads the most Damaging Poison on enemies you kill in a (1.5-1.8) metre radius
(10-29)% chance to Hinder enemies on spreading Poison to them
description: While active, killing a Poisoned enemy spreads its Poison to other nearby enemies, and has a chance to also Hinder them.
skillStats: Spreads the most Damaging Poison on enemies you kill in a (1.5-1.8) metre radius
(10-29)% chance to Hinder enemies on spreading Poison to them

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent buff. Killing a poisoned enemy spreads its strongest poison to everything within about 1.5 to 1.8 metres, sometimes hindering them too.
beginner.whyItMatters: Poison is slow and single-target by nature, and this converts each finished kill into fresh poison on the neighbours.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Run it on a poison build in packed areas. The chain only starts once something dies, so it does very little against a lone boss.

name: Herald of Thunder
stats: Lightning Bolts strike the targets of your next (2-3) Attack Hits after killing a Shocked enemy with Attack damage
description: While active, killing Shocked enemies with a non-Herald Attack Hit will cause subsequent Attack Hits to release lightning bolts which deals Attack damage to all surrounding enemies.
skillStats: Lightning Bolts strike the targets of your next (2-3) Attack Hits after killing a Shocked enemy with Attack damage

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent buff. After you kill a shocked enemy with an attack, your next two or three attack hits each call down lightning on everything nearby.
beginner.whyItMatters: It gives a shock build a burst of area damage that arrives just after a kill, which is exactly when you are turning to the next target.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Take it once you shock reliably. The window is only a handful of hits, so it favours faster attacks over a single slow swing.

name: Hexblast
stats: Explodes a Curse on enemies in a 2.8 metre radius
description: Detonate a Curse on every enemy in an area, causing explosions of Chaos damage but removing the Curse. Can only detonate Curses for which at least half of the duration has expired.
skillStats: Explodes a Curse on enemies in a 2.8 metre radius

beginner.whatItIs: A spell that detonates a curse on every cursed enemy within 2.8 metres for chaos damage, up to ten explosions per cast, and removes the curse in the process.
beginner.whyItMatters: It makes cursing an offensive act rather than a setup step, but it consumes the curse, so you cannot keep both the debuff and the damage.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Curse a group, let at least half the curse duration run, then detonate. Casting it early does nothing, because a fresh curse cannot be exploded.

name: High Velocity Rounds
description: Load your Crossbow with Piercing bolts that apply Riven Armour to enemies with Fully Broken Armour, causing any Hits against those enemies to deal extra damage.

beginner.whatItIs: A crossbow ammunition skill loading piercing bolts that apply Riven Armour to enemies whose armour is already fully broken, making every later hit on them hit harder.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is a damage amplifier rather than a damage skill, so its value is entirely in what you fire afterwards.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it after something has broken the target's armour, then swap back to your main clip. On an enemy with intact armour it is just a piercing bolt.

name: His Foul Emergence
description: Conjure a horrific skull rising from the lightless depths to bite your enemies dealing high damage at target location and leaving Withering Ground in its wake. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast.

beginner.whatItIs: A spell that raises a giant skull at the target point for heavy physical and chaos damage in a 2.8 metre area, leaving withering ground behind for eight seconds.
beginner.whyItMatters: The withering ground keeps stacking a chaos-damage-taken debuff on anything standing in it, so the aftermath is worth as much as the bite.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Drop it where enemies must walk. It adds a full second to your cast time, so cast it from range or you will be standing still while a pack arrives.

name: His Grave Command
stats: While this Gem is Socketed you can view Monster Categories on Enemies
Bound Undead retains up to four monster modifiers when summoned
description: Conjure Abyssal spirits to Hinder a Rare Undead for a duration. If you defeat the Undead while it is Hindered, it will be captured and stored into a Soul Crystal Skill Gem. The Soul Crystal will allow a wielder of great Abyssal power to summon the bound Undead as a Reviving Companion.
skillStats: While this Gem is Socketed you can view Monster Categories on Enemies
Bound Undead retains up to four monster modifiers when summoned

beginner.whatItIs: A capture skill. It hinders a rare undead for eight to twelve seconds, and if you kill it while hindered the monster is bound into a Soul Crystal you can later summon as a reviving companion.
beginner.whyItMatters: It lets you pick your own minion out of the world instead of taking whatever the gem gives you, keeping up to four of that monster's modifiers.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Cast it on a rare undead with modifiers you actually want before you start killing it. Ordinary and unique monsters are not valid targets.

name: His Scattering Calamity
stats: Duration between launching Wellsprites is 1.2 seconds
Modifiers to number of Projectiles instead apply to number of Wellsprites accumulated
10% more Damage for each previous Wellsprite fired in sequence
description: Conjure a crackling Wellsprite that hovers above you. After a short duration, the Wellsprite launches at an enemy, dealing Lightning damage in an area on impact and prioritising the last enemy targeted. Recasting this spell resets the duration for all active Wellsprites.
skillStats: Duration between launching Wellsprites is 1.2 seconds
Modifiers to number of Projectiles instead apply to number of Wellsprites accumulated
10% more Damage for each previous Wellsprite fired in sequence

beginner.whatItIs: A spell that stacks crackling Wellsprites above you, up to ten. Every 1.2 seconds one launches at an enemy and chains for lightning damage.
beginner.whyItMatters: Each sprite in a sequence hits 10% harder than the one before it, so the payoff grows the longer you build the stack before a fight.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Cast it repeatedly as you approach a pack so the sprites are already stacked when you arrive. Recasting resets the launch timer on all of them.

name: His Vile Intrusion
description: Target an enemy to either teleport inside the target's body if they are under the Cull threshold, causing it to violently explode, or to apply a Debuff to them, which will cause the same effect if that enemy falls under the Cull threshold during its duration. On teleport, the target is destroyed, and the explosion deals Physical damage to surrounding enemies and inflicts Impale.

beginner.whatItIs: A spell that teleports you inside an enemy that is already below the cull threshold and destroys it, exploding for physical damage in a 4 metre radius and impaling everything nearby. On a healthier target it applies a four second debuff that does the same thing if the target drops low.
beginner.whyItMatters: It turns finishing off a weakened enemy into a large area explosion, so execution and clearing become the same action.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it on the low-health enemy inside a pack, not the healthy one at the edge. The debuff version lets you pre-place the explosion on a target you are about to burn down.

name: His Winnowing Flame
description: Conjure an abyssal scythe that sweeps across the targeted area, dealing Fire damage to enemies and Consuming Ignite to create pillars of flame. Cannot be Triggered.

beginner.whatItIs: A spell that sweeps an abyssal scythe over the target area for fire damage, consuming ignite on what it hits to raise pillars of flame. It has culling strike and cannot be triggered.
beginner.whyItMatters: Culling strike means it finishes enemies outright below a life threshold, so it closes fights faster than its damage number suggests.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Cast it into a group you have already ignited so the pillars appear. Because it cannot be triggered, it has to be a button you actually press.

name: Hollow Resonance
description: Attaches an ethereal bell to your back. Critical Hits with other Skills will cause the bell to ring out, damaging nearby enemies.

beginner.whatItIs: An ethereal bell strapped to your back. Critical hits from your other skills make it ring, damaging enemies within 2 metres with 150% more stun buildup.
beginner.whyItMatters: It adds area damage and stun pressure to a single-target critical build without occupying a slot on your bar.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Take it on a build with high critical hit chance and a weapon it accepts. Low crit chance means the bell rarely rings.

name: Hollow Shell
stats: Pulse spends 100% of your Runic Ward to grant Allies
Guard equal to (45-64)% of Runic Ward spent
Cannot affect the same target more than once every 6 seconds
description: Sacrifice your Runic Ward to send out an energy pulse that grants nearby Allies Guard.
skillStats: Pulse spends 100% of your Runic Ward to grant Allies
Guard equal to (45-64)% of Runic Ward spent
Cannot affect the same target more than once every 6 seconds

beginner.whatItIs: A spell that spends all of your Runic Ward to pulse outward three to four metres, granting nearby allies Guard worth 45% to 64% of the ward you spent, for six seconds.
beginner.whyItMatters: It converts your own defensive pool into protection for the party, which is the sort of thing nobody else in the group can do for themselves.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Fire it just before a telegraphed hit lands on the group. Each ally can only be shielded again after six seconds, so spamming it wastes ward.

name: Ice Nova
description: Conjure a wave of ice in all directions, Knocking Back enemies based on how close they are to you. Casting Ice Nova targeting near a Frostbolt Projectile will cause it to originate from the Frostbolt instead of you. Consumes a Cold Infusion if possible to leave a patch of Chilled Ground.

beginner.whatItIs: A spell that bursts a wave of ice 3.2 metres in every direction, knocking enemies back harder the closer they are, with heavily boosted chill and freeze buildup.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is both your panic button and your freeze setup, because the knockback buys space at the same time the freeze buildup lands.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Cast it when a pack has closed on you. Targeting it near one of your Frostbolt projectiles makes the nova erupt from the bolt instead, which is how you use it at range.

name: Ice Shards
description: Load your Crossbow with a clip of icy bolts that rapidly fire at the ground, leaving a shard of ice at the impact location that arms after a duration. After arming, the ice shards explode when enemies step on them, dealing more damage the longer they have been armed, up to a maximum. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.

beginner.whatItIs: A crossbow skill that fires sixteen icy bolts at the ground. Each leaves a shard that arms, then explodes when an enemy steps on it, hitting harder the longer it has been armed.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is a trap layer rather than a shooter, so the damage depends on preparation time instead of on your attack speed.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Carpet the ground before you pull, then let enemies walk in. Firing into an enemy already on top of you gives shards no time to arm.

name: Ice Shot
stats: Converts 80% of Physical damage to Cold damage
description: Fire an icy arrow that sprays a cone of ice shards when it hits a target.
skillStats: Converts 80% of Physical damage to Cold damage

beginner.whatItIs: A bow attack that converts 80% of its physical damage to cold and sprays a cone of ice shards behind whatever it hits.
beginner.whyItMatters: The cone turns a single arrow into pack clear, and the boosted chill and freeze buildup make it a freeze engine as well as a damage skill.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Aim at the enemy in front of a group so the cone catches the rest. It is a strong first bow skill and stays useful into cold-focused builds.

name: Ice Strike
stats: Converts 80% of Physical damage to Cold damage
description: Perform a fast icy Strike. Using this Attack three times in quick succession causes a final strike that is slower and more powerful.
skillStats: Converts 80% of Physical damage to Cold damage
