beginner.whatItIs: A fast quarterstaff strike converting 80% of physical damage to cold. Using it three times in a row makes the third hit slower and much stronger.
beginner.whyItMatters: The three-hit rhythm means your damage depends on staying on a target rather than on hitting once and moving, which shapes how the whole build plays.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Commit to full three-hit sequences on anything that will survive them. Against scattered trash the first two hits are usually enough.

name: Ice-Tipped Arrows
description: Ready your active Bow or Spear, Empowering your next Barrageable Bow or Projectile Spear Attacks to Convert Physical Damage to Cold Damage and create Ice Fragments on Hit. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Frenzy Charge. Cannot Empower Sustained Skills.

beginner.whatItIs: A buff for your active bow or spear. It empowers your next four barrageable bow or projectile spear attacks to convert physical damage to cold and create ice fragments on hit.
beginner.whyItMatters: It bolts a cold conversion and an extra source of hits onto a weapon skill that had neither, for the price of a short setup.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Press it just before a burst window on a boss. Spending a Frenzy Charge skips the cooldown, so a charge-generating build can keep it up far more often.

name: Icestorm
stats: Improves 1 Bolt per Power of enemies from which Freeze is Consumed
Can Hit each enemy only once every 0.15 seconds
description: Conjure a hail of icy bolts over the targeted area. Chill and Freeze on enemies in front of you are Consumed to fuel the Icestorm by creating improved bolts.
skillStats: Improves 1 Bolt per Power of enemies from which Freeze is Consumed
Can Hit each enemy only once every 0.15 seconds

beginner.whatItIs: A sustained spell raining icy bolts over a 2.6 metre area for six seconds, one impact every 0.15 seconds. Chill and freeze on enemies in front of you are eaten to upgrade individual bolts.
beginner.whyItMatters: It converts ailments you have already applied into raw damage, so a cold build gets paid twice for the same freeze.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Chill or freeze a group first, then drop the storm on them. You can have three active at once, so overlapping them on a boss is the way to burst.

name: Impurity
description: Emit an Aura that boosts the Chaos Resistance of you and Allies in your Presence.

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent aura granting you and allies in your Presence between 10% and 29% chaos resistance.
beginner.whyItMatters: Chaos resistance is hard to come by on gear and chaos damage ignores energy shield, so a flat aura fixes a gap most characters have.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Run it while levelling through chaos-heavy areas or before a fight known for chaos damage. Swap it out once your gear covers the resistance.

name: Incendiary Shot
stats: Converts 80% of Physical Damage to Fire Damage
Ignites you inflict with this skill deal Damage 200% faster
Consumes 30 Heat if possible to gain 50% more Ignite Magnitude
Bolts shatter on impact, dealing Damage in a 1.9 metre cone
30% increased Ignite duration for each Fragment in a single hit
Multiple fragments can Hit the same target
Multiple Fragments hitting a target simultaneously will combine their damage into a single Hit
description: Load your Crossbow with flaming bolts that fragment in flight, damaging and Igniting enemies on hit and in a small cone behind their final target. These fragments can Merge.
skillStats: Converts 80% of Physical Damage to Fire Damage
Ignites you inflict with this skill deal Damage 200% faster
Consumes 30 Heat if possible to gain 50% more Ignite Magnitude
Bolts shatter on impact, dealing Damage in a 1.9 metre cone
30% increased Ignite duration for each Fragment in a single hit
Multiple fragments can Hit the same target
Multiple Fragments hitting a target simultaneously will combine their damage into a single Hit

beginner.whatItIs: A crossbow skill firing flaming bolts that fragment into ten pieces, hitting the target and a 1.9 metre cone behind it, with ignites that burn 200% faster.
beginner.whyItMatters: Multiple fragments landing on one target combine into a single hit, so a packed target takes one very large ignite instead of several small ones.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Fire it into the front of a tightly packed group. Consuming 30 Heat adds 50% more ignite magnitude, so it pairs with the crossbow skills that build heat.

name: Incinerate
stats: Ignites from a single use of this Skill Compound if not from Ignited Ground
Gains (7-2) milliseconds of fuel per Mana spent
Can store up to 5 seconds of fuel
Ignites as though dealing (2-83) to (4-124) Fire damage, every 0.075 seconds
description: Gain fuel by spending Mana on any Skill, then use the accumulated fuel to conjure a torrent of Fire from your hand, Igniting enemies in front of you. The flames grow stronger the longer you Channel. Consumes a Fire Infusion if possible to also create Ignited Ground. Cannot gain fuel while using this skill.
skillStats: Ignites from a single use of this Skill Compound if not from Ignited Ground
Gains (7-2) milliseconds of fuel per Mana spent
Can store up to 5 seconds of fuel
Ignites as though dealing (2-83) to (4-124) Fire damage, every 0.075 seconds

beginner.whatItIs: A channelled flamethrower that runs on fuel. Spending mana on any skill banks fuel, up to five seconds of it, and channelling burns that fuel into a growing cone of fire 5.8 metres long.
beginner.whyItMatters: The fuel system means your damage is limited by what you spent earlier, not by your mana bar right now, which is an unusual constraint to build around.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Spend mana freely between packs, then dump the stored fuel on a boss. You cannot gain fuel while channelling, so it is a burst window rather than a sustained skill.

name: Inevitable Agony
stats: Debuffed targets lose life equal to 25% of Hit Damage dealt to them while Debuffed when Debuff expires
Culls enemies if Debuff reaches Culling Strike Threshold
description: Debuff all targets in an area, causing a portion of Damage they take from Hits to be tracked by the Debuff. When the debuff's duration expires or can kill the target, the target loses life equal to that tracked damage all at once.
skillStats: Debuffed targets lose life equal to 25% of Hit Damage dealt to them while Debuffed when Debuff expires
Culls enemies if Debuff reaches Culling Strike Threshold

beginner.whatItIs: A debuff on everything in an area that quietly records 25% of all hit damage dealt to those enemies, then takes that recorded amount off their life in one go when it expires after twelve seconds.
beginner.whyItMatters: It delays a quarter of your damage and pays it out as a single lump, which can finish an enemy the moment the debuff lands even if it looked healthy.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Apply it at the start of a fight so it collects the whole exchange. It also culls a target that crosses the culling threshold, so it doubles as a finisher on a long boss.

name: Infernal Cry
stats: Empowered Attacks Gain (30-49)% of damage as extra Fire damage
Empowers one Attack per 10 enemy Power in range, counting up to 50 Power
description: Perform a Warcry, Empowering subsequent Melee Attacks if there are enemies nearby. Enemies in the warcry's area are destabilised and will Combust on death. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge.
skillStats: Empowered Attacks Gain (30-49)% of damage as extra Fire damage
Empowers one Attack per 10 enemy Power in range, counting up to 50 Power

beginner.whatItIs: A warcry with a 4 metre radius that empowers your next melee attacks to gain 30% to 49% of their damage as extra fire damage, and destabilises enemies so they combust when they die.
beginner.whyItMatters: It converts standing in a crowd into a damage buff, because the number of attacks it empowers scales with how much enemy power is nearby.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Shout it inside a big pack rather than at a lone target, since a small group empowers only one or two attacks. Spending an Endurance Charge skips its cooldown.

name: Into the Breach
stats: A Flame of Chayula manifests within 8.5m of you every (1.4-1.21) seconds
Flames of Chayula fade after 25 seconds if not picked up
Flame of Chayula within 5m of you are revealed
Flames of Chayula have (0-50)% increased effect
description: Create a Breach around you, allowing you to see nearby Flames of Chayula. You are considered to be in a Breach while this skill is active.
skillStats: A Flame of Chayula manifests within 8.5m of you every (1.4-1.21) seconds
Flames of Chayula fade after 25 seconds if not picked up
Flame of Chayula within 5m of you are revealed
Flames of Chayula have (0-50)% increased effect

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent skill that opens a Breach around you, spawning a Flame of Chayula within 8.5 metres roughly every 1.2 to 1.4 seconds and revealing any within 5 metres.
beginner.whyItMatters: It counts you as being inside a Breach at all times, which is what a whole family of Breach-conditional gear and passives is looking for.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Run it on a build that pays off Flames of Chayula or Breach conditions. Flames vanish after 25 seconds, so it wants a character that moves through them rather than one that stands still.

name: Iron Ward
stats: Stores (100-480)% of mitigated Physical damage, up to (65-22886)
description: While active, stores a percentage of the Physical damage that is prevented by your Armour or other sources of damage reduction. Using this Skill releases the stored damage as a nova of spikes.
skillStats: Stores (100-480)% of mitigated Physical damage, up to (65-22886)

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent buff that banks 100% to 480% of the physical damage your armour and reductions prevented. Pressing the skill releases the stored total as a nova of spikes.
beginner.whyItMatters: It converts pure defence into offence, so a heavily armoured character finally gets damage out of getting hit.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Tank a big physical hit, then release. Releasing early wastes the stored value, and the storage caps out, so do not sit on a full charge.

name: Kelari, the Tainted Sands
description: Summon Kelari, an invulnerable Sand Djinn Minion, to do your bidding. Kelari will only act when you Command him to do so. Kelari delivers swift Hits with massive Critical Hit potential.

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent minion that summons Kelari, an invulnerable Sand Djinn who acts only when you Command him. He hits fast, applies Critical Weakness, and carries a 50% increased critical damage bonus.
beginner.whyItMatters: Because he cannot die, he is a permanent damage floor that no amount of incoming damage takes away from you.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Take him on a build that wants a controllable critical striker and has the spirit for it. He does nothing on his own, so you must actually use his Command skills.

name: Kelari's Deception
stats: 50% more damage for each previous time this Skill has been used consecutively
Clone explosions inflict 2 additional Critical Weakness on Hit
50% more damage for each previous time this Skill has been used consecutively
description: Command Kelari to create a blast at the target location that deals Spell damage, and leave behind a clone that persists for a short duration. This skill can store multiple charges, and using it again while a clone from a previous use is still alive causes that clone to explode, dealing even more damage.
skillStats: 50% more damage for each previous time this Skill has been used consecutively
Clone explosions inflict 2 additional Critical Weakness on Hit
50% more damage for each previous time this Skill has been used consecutively

beginner.whatItIs: A Command skill that makes Kelari blast a 2.5 metre area and leave a clone behind. Using it again while an old clone lives detonates that clone for even more damage.
beginner.whyItMatters: Each consecutive use deals 50% more damage than the last, so the skill rewards a rhythm of repeated casts rather than a single press.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Chain it on a boss to climb the consecutive-use bonus, placing each new blast on top of the previous clone. Breaking the chain resets the ramp.

name: Kelari's Judgment
description: A channelled Command skill that has Kelari deal physical damage in an area at the target location.

beginner.whatItIs: A channelled Command skill that has Kelari deal physical damage in an area at the target location.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is the sustained option in Kelari's Command set, so it covers the case where you want to hold a spot rather than burst it.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Channel it while a target is locked down and you are safe to stand still.

name: Kelari's Malediction
description: Harness Kelari's power to passively Consume Corpses in your Presence, causing Corpse Beetle Minions to burst forth. The Beetles passively follow you until Commanded. On your Command, they rush the target and explode.

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent skill where Kelari eats corpses in your Presence, spawning two Corpse Beetles each time, up to eight. The beetles follow you until you Command them to rush a target and explode.
beginner.whyItMatters: It converts the corpses a fight leaves behind into stored burst damage you can release on your own timing.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Build a stack of beetles clearing trash, then release them into a rare or boss. Corpses are consumed roughly every second, so a long fight with no adds will not refill them.

name: Killing Palm
stats: Dashes and Strikes additional valid targets
Normal and Magic monsters grant 1 Power Charge
description: Dash to an enemy and Strike them, Culling enemies if their life is low enough and performing additional dashing Strikes to other Cullable targets in range if your target was Culled. Each enemy killed by this strike grants a Power Charge, with higher Rarity monsters granting additional Charges. Enemies around you that can be Culled will be highlighted.
skillStats: Dashes and Strikes additional valid targets
Normal and Magic monsters grant 1 Power Charge

beginner.whatItIs: A quarterstaff dash-strike that culls low-life enemies. If the target is culled, you chain more dashing strikes to other cullable targets nearby, and each kill grants Power Charges - one from normal and magic monsters, two from rares, three from uniques.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is one of the cheapest ways to refill Power Charges, and it highlights valid targets for you, so charge generation stops being guesswork.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Save it for the end of a pack once things are already hurt. Opening a fight with it wastes it, because nothing is low enough to cull.

name: Leap Slam
stats: +0.65 seconds to Total Attack Time, plus up to +0.5 seconds based on distance travelled
While Dual Wielding, both weapons hit with 30% less damage
Consumes Fully Broken Armour on enemies to cause 500% more Stun buildup
description:
Jump into the air, damaging and Knocking Back enemies with your mace where you land. Enemies you would land on are
pushed out of the way.
skillStats: +0.65 seconds to Total Attack Time, plus up to +0.5 seconds based on distance travelled
While Dual Wielding, both weapons hit with 30% less damage
Consumes Fully Broken Armour on enemies to cause 500% more Stun buildup

beginner.whatItIs: A mace skill that jumps you to a target point, damaging and knocking back enemies where you land in a 2.5 metre area, with 50% to 88% more stun buildup.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is a movement skill that arrives as a real attack, which is how a slow mace character crosses ground without giving up damage.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it to close on a pack and open with the stun. Against an enemy whose armour is fully broken it causes 500% more stun buildup, so break armour first when you want the heavy stun.

name: Leylines
stats: Deal (10-29)% more Spell damage while on a Leyline
Lose (3.43-93.03) Runic Ward per second while on a Leyline
Cannot Recover Runic Ward while on a Leyline
description: While active, areas of intense runic energy are revealed to you. Standing over them grants you a powerful Spell damage boost but constantly drains your Runic Ward. Running out of Runic Ward causes the energy to temporarily dissipate.
skillStats: Deal (10-29)% more Spell damage while on a Leyline
Lose (3.43-93.03) Runic Ward per second while on a Leyline
Cannot Recover Runic Ward while on a Leyline

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent skill that reveals patches of runic energy on the ground. Standing on one gives 10% to 29% more spell damage but drains Runic Ward continuously, and you cannot recover ward while on it.
beginner.whyItMatters: It makes positioning matter for a caster: the damage is real, but it costs a defensive pool and running dry makes the patch disappear for eight seconds.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Step onto a leyline for a burst window on a boss, then step off to recover. Fighting permanently on one only works with heavy Runic Ward generation.

name: Life Remnants
stats: 25% chance to spawn a Remnant on killing an enemy
Spawn a Remnant on Hitting a target, no more than once every 3 seconds
description: Drink the blood of your enemies to restore your Life. While active, enemies you kill have a chance to spawn a Life Remnant, and Hitting a target spawns a Life Remnant every few seconds. Picking up a Life Remnant grants you Life which can Overflow maximum Life.
skillStats: 25% chance to spawn a Remnant on killing an enemy
Spawn a Remnant on Hitting a target, no more than once every 3 seconds

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent skill. Enemies you kill have a 25% chance to drop a Life Remnant, and hitting anything drops one every three seconds. Picking one up restores life and can push you past your maximum.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is recovery tied to fighting rather than to flasks or regeneration, and the overflow means a good fight leaves you better than full.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Run it on a melee character who is already standing where the remnants drop. A ranged build that never walks forward collects very few, since they last eight seconds.

name: Lightning Arrow
stats: Converts 80% of Physical damage to Lightning damage
Fires beams at up to (2-4) additional Enemies near the target
description: Fire a charged arrow at the target. On hitting an enemy or wall, the arrow will fire Chaining Lightning beams at nearby enemies.
skillStats: Converts 80% of Physical damage to Lightning damage
Fires beams at up to (2-4) additional Enemies near the target

beginner.whatItIs: A bow attack that converts 80% of physical damage to lightning. On hitting an enemy or a wall it fires separate lightning beams at up to four more enemies within 3.2 metres of the target.
beginner.whyItMatters: One arrow becomes several hits without you aiming at anything but the nearest target, which is why it is a standard early bow clear skill.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Shoot the closest enemy in a group and let the beams find the rest. It also works fired at a wall next to a pack.

name: Lightning Bolt
description: Call down a Shocking bolt of Lightning to strike enemies in a small area.

beginner.whatItIs: A spell calling a bolt of lightning down on a small 0.8 metre area, with 200% more chance to shock.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is a cheap, reliable way to apply shock, which is a debuff that increases all damage the target takes.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it to shock a priority target before your heavier skills land. Its area is small, so it is a single-target tool rather than pack clear.

name: Lightning Conduit
stats: 10% more damage with Hits per 5% Shock Effect on Enemy
(1-2) additional bolts if a Shocked enemy is in the target area
description: Call down Lightning to hit all enemies in a cone in front of you, dealing significantly more damage to Shocked enemies. If there is a Shocked enemy in the target area, additional lightning bolts are distributed among the targets hit. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast.
skillStats: 10% more damage with Hits per 5% Shock Effect on Enemy
(1-2) additional bolts if a Shocked enemy is in the target area

beginner.whatItIs: A spell that calls lightning down a 10 metre cone in front of you, dealing 10% more damage for every 5% of shock effect on the target, plus extra bolts if a shocked enemy is in the area.
beginner.whyItMatters: Its damage is written almost entirely in terms of shock, so it is close to useless without a shock source and very large with one.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Shock first, then cast. It adds a full second to your cast time and jumps you backwards when you target close, so it wants distance.

name: Lightning Rod
stats: Converts 100% of Physical damage to Lightning damage
Arrow disappears after being Chained to 8 times
description: Fire an arrow that drops from above, creating a Lightning burst. The arrow remains in the ground, and any Chaining Lightning beams can Chain to it. When Chained to, the arrows charge up for a brief period before releasing another Lightning burst. The Lightning Arrow Skill reduces this delay, causing bursts to happen more quickly.
skillStats: Converts 100% of Physical damage to Lightning damage
Arrow disappears after being Chained to 8 times

beginner.whatItIs: A bow attack that plants an arrow in the ground and bursts lightning in a 2 metre area. The arrow stays up to twenty seconds and any chaining lightning beam can chain to it, triggering another burst.
beginner.whyItMatters: It stores damage in the terrain, so a build with chaining lightning gets repeat explosions from arrows it fired minutes of fighting ago.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Plant up to ten arrows around a boss arena, then chain into them with Lightning Arrow, which specifically shortens their charge delay. Each arrow expires after eight chains.

name: Lightning Spear
stats: Converts 80% of Physical damage to Lightning damage
Spear cannot Pierce, Fork, Chain or Return
Modifiers to the number of Projectiles fired only affect the maximum number of lightning bolt Projectiles
Splits towards 3 targets when Consuming a Frenzy Charge
Projectiles can Split from hitting terrain
description: Throw a single copy of your spear. When it hits an enemy it bursts, firing secondary lightning bolt Projectiles at multiple other enemies within a large area around it. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if possible to cause the main spear to split into multiple copies on impact, each of which then bursts.
skillStats: Converts 80% of Physical damage to Lightning damage
Spear cannot Pierce, Fork, Chain or Return
Modifiers to the number of Projectiles fired only affect the maximum number of lightning bolt Projectiles
Splits towards 3 targets when Consuming a Frenzy Charge
Projectiles can Split from hitting terrain

beginner.whatItIs: A thrown spear that bursts on hit, firing secondary lightning bolts at several other enemies in a large radius, with 100% more chance to shock.
beginner.whyItMatters: It converts a single-target throw into wide shock application, which is the setup other lightning skills want.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Throw it into the middle of a pack. Spending a Frenzy Charge splits the main spear towards three targets, so it scales up sharply with charge generation.

name: Lightning Warp
stats: Explosion and Shocked Ground radius are 3 metres
description: Target an enemy to either teleport inside the target's body if they are under the Cull threshold, causing it to violently explode, or to apply a Debuff to them, which will cause the same effect if that enemy falls under the Cull threshold during its duration. Can also be used on Ball Lightning Projectiles. On teleport, the target is destroyed, and the explosion deals Lightning damage to surrounding enemies. If targeting an enemy, the explosion also creates Shocked Ground. Creates a Lightning Infusion on successful use. Highlights enemies that can be Culled.
skillStats: Explosion and Shocked Ground radius are 3 metres

beginner.whatItIs: A spell that teleports you inside an enemy below the cull threshold and destroys it, exploding for lightning damage and leaving shocked ground for eight seconds. On a healthy target it leaves a four second debuff that does the same if the target drops low.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is a finisher, a repositioning tool and a ground hazard in one press, and it creates a Lightning Infusion each successful use.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it to jump into a pack through a dying enemy. It also works on Ball Lightning projectiles, which is how you use it as movement with nothing to cull.

name: Lingering Illusion
stats: Illusions have 1% of your maximum Life
(0—76)% chance to create an additional Remnant
description: While active, creates a short-lived illusory copy of yourself whenever you dodge roll. The copy can be damaged by enemies, and copies that are destroyed by an enemy will drop a Remnant that grants you a Power Charge on pickup.
skillStats: Illusions have 1% of your maximum Life
(0—76)% chance to create an additional Remnant

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent buff that leaves an illusory copy of you every time you dodge roll. The copy has 1% of your life, lasts three seconds, and drops a Remnant granting a Power Charge if an enemy destroys it.
beginner.whyItMatters: It pays you charges for dodging, which is something you were doing anyway, and the copies draw enemy attention while they live.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Run it on a character that rolls constantly. Illusions only pay out when an enemy actually kills them, so it does nothing if you roll away from the fight.

name: Living Bomb
stats: Explodes after enemy is dealt damage equal to 200% of its Ailment Threshold
description: Plant a seed of Fire inside an enemy. Dealing enough damage to the enemy, or killing it outright, causes the seed to explode, dealing damage in an area and leaving behind a Fire Infusion Remnant.
skillStats: Explodes after enemy is dealt damage equal to 200% of its Ailment Threshold

beginner.whatItIs: A spell that plants a fire seed inside one enemy. Dealing damage worth 200% of that enemy's ailment threshold, or killing it, explodes the seed in a 2.5 metre area and leaves a Fire Infusion Remnant.
beginner.whyItMatters: It converts damage you are already dealing to one target into an area explosion, and the remnant feeds skills that consume infusions.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Plant it on an enemy in the middle of a group before you burst it down. Only one seed can be active, so pick the target that is surrounded.

name: Lunar Assault
stats: Converts 80% of Physical damage to Cold damage
description: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and swipe with your claws, projecting an arc of moonlight and ice forward in a crescent.
skillStats: Converts 80% of Physical damage to Cold damage

beginner.whatItIs: A werewolf shapeshift attack that swipes a crescent of moonlight and ice forward, converting 80% of physical damage to cold with hugely boosted chill and freeze buildup.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is how a shapeshift build applies freeze, since the chill and freeze buildup multipliers are far larger than an ordinary attack carries.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Lead with it against groups you want frozen. It shifts you into werewolf form, so use it when you intend to stay in that form for a while.

name: Lunar Blessing
stats: Knocks back enemies in a 4 metre radius
Buff duration is 5 seconds, plus 0.2 seconds per Rage spent
Buff grants (40-59)% of damage Gained as Cold damage
description: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and offer your Rage to the moon to receive a blessing, gaining bonus Cold damage for yourself and any Wolf Minions you have from Wolf Pack or Predator's Mark. Spends all Rage to extend the Buff's duration. While the Buff is active, your Werewolf Melee Attacks call down Moonbeams on Hit.
skillStats: Knocks back enemies in a 4 metre radius
Buff duration is 5 seconds, plus 0.2 seconds per Rage spent
Buff grants (40-59)% of damage Gained as Cold damage

beginner.whatItIs: A werewolf warcry that spends all your Rage to gain a buff granting 40% to 59% of damage as extra cold damage for you and your wolves, lasting five seconds plus 0.2 seconds per Rage spent.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is the payoff for Rage on a cold shapeshift build, and while it is up your werewolf melee hits call down moonbeams.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Spend it at maximum Rage right before a boss, since the duration is bought with Rage. Using it at low Rage gets you a five second buff and little else.

name: Mace Strike
stats: While Dual Wielding, both weapons hit with 30% less attack speed
description: Strike with your Maces.
skillStats: While Dual Wielding, both weapons hit with 30% less attack speed

beginner.whatItIs: The default one-hand mace attack. It strikes a single enemy with a small area around the impact.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is what you have before you find anything better, and it exists so a mace is never a dead weapon.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it while levelling until a real mace skill is available. There is no reason to keep it on the bar after that.

name: Magma Barrier
stats: 5 to 7 Added Fire damage per 15 Armour on Shield
5 to 7 Added Fire damage per 15 Evasion on Shield
(4-103) to (6-155) Base Off Hand Fire Damage
description: While active, increases your Block Chance passively and imbues your Shield with lava over time. When fully imbued, your next Block with your Shield raised will expend the lava to create an explosion, granting you an Endurance Charge.
skillStats: 5 to 7 Added Fire damage per 15 Armour on Shield
5 to 7 Added Fire damage per 15 Evasion on Shield
(4-103) to (6-155) Base Off Hand Fire Damage

beginner.whatItIs: A shield skill that coats your shield in magma for half a second each time you raise it, letting a blocked moment answer back with a Magma Spray that adds fire damage scaled off the armour on your shield.
beginner.whyItMatters: It gives a blocking character an offensive reason to raise the shield, which otherwise costs you damage time.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it on a shield build with high armour on the shield itself, since the added fire damage is written per 15 armour. The magma cannot be refreshed for 0.75 seconds after it fades, so raising the shield constantly does not help.

name: Magnetic Salvo
stats: Converts 80% of Physical damage to Lightning damage
description: Aim skyward and fires energy missiles at lingering bolts or arrows created by other Lightning Attacks in front of you. The missiles explode if they land close to a lingering bolt or arrow, dealing more damage in a larger area but destroying that bolt or arrow in the process.
skillStats: Converts 80% of Physical damage to Lightning damage

beginner.whatItIs: A bow attack that fires up to eight energy missiles skyward at lingering bolts or arrows your other lightning attacks left in the ground. Missiles that land near one explode in a larger area but destroy it.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is a payoff skill with no value of its own, cashing in the terrain another skill set up.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it after planting arrows with Lightning Rod or a similar skill. Firing it on empty ground is close to wasted.

name: Malice
stats: Applies Critical Weakness to enemies every (0.7-0.51) seconds
description: While active, emits an Aura that continuously inflicts Critical Weakness on enemies in your Presence.
skillStats: Applies Critical Weakness to enemies every (0.7-0.51) seconds

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent aura that reapplies Critical Weakness to enemies in your Presence every 0.5 to 0.7 seconds, lasting four seconds each time.
beginner.whyItMatters: It keeps a critical-damage debuff permanently on everything near you without a single button press.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Run it on any critical hit build. It gives nothing to a character that never crits, so check your crit chance before reserving the spirit.

name: Mana Drain
description: Leech Mana from an enemy over a prolonged period, as well as briefly Hindering them.

beginner.whatItIs: A spell that leeches 30 to 408 mana from an enemy over an extended period and briefly hinders them.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is mana sustain that comes from the enemy rather than from your regeneration, which matters for a caster whose costs outpace their pool.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Cast it on a durable target at the start of a long fight, because the leech is 70% slower than normal and needs time to pay out. It is wasted on trash that dies immediately.

name: Mana Remnants
stats: 25% chance to spawn a Remnant on killing an enemy affected by an Elemental Ailment
Spawn a Remnant on Critically Hitting a target affected by an Elemental Ailment, no more than once every 2 seconds
description: Conjure surging arcane energy to restore your Mana. While active, enemies you kill affected by Elemental Ailments have a chance to spawn a Mana Remnant, and Critically Hitting a target with Elemental Ailments spawns a Mana Remnant every few seconds. Picking up a Mana Remnant grants you Mana which can Overflow maximum Mana.
skillStats: 25% chance to spawn a Remnant on killing an enemy affected by an Elemental Ailment
Spawn a Remnant on Critically Hitting a target affected by an Elemental Ailment, no more than once every 2 seconds

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent skill. Killing an enemy that has an elemental ailment has a 25% chance to drop a Mana Remnant, and critically hitting an ailing enemy drops one every two seconds. Picking one up restores mana past your maximum.
beginner.whyItMatters: It ties mana recovery to landing ailments, so an elemental caster funds its own casting by doing what it already does.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Run it on a build that freezes, shocks or ignites reliably. Without ailments it produces nothing at all.

name: Mana Tempest
stats: Cooldown does not recover during Buff effect
Effects of Mana Tempest linger for 2.0 seconds after leaving the Tempest
Empowered Spells Split to (1-3) additional targets
30% of Mana and Life spent while in the storm is added to this Skill's Mana Cost per Second
Empowered Spells Gain (40-78)% of damage as Lightning Damage
description: Create a storm of arcane energies that Empowers your Mana-costing Spells while you remain inside it. Maintaining the storm constantly drains your Mana, and spending more causes it to drain faster. The storm will dissipate when you exit it or run out of Mana. This skill can not be triggered.
skillStats: Cooldown does not recover during Buff effect
Effects of Mana Tempest linger for 2.0 seconds after leaving the Tempest
Empowered Spells Split to (1-3) additional targets
30% of Mana and Life spent while in the storm is added to this Skill's Mana Cost per Second
Empowered Spells Gain (40-78)% of damage as Lightning Damage

beginner.whatItIs: A storm you stand inside. While you are in it, your mana-costing spells gain 40% to 78% of their damage as lightning and split to up to three extra targets, while the storm drains mana faster the more you spend.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is a burst window bought with mana, and it dissipates if you walk out or run dry, so it forces you to hold a position.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Drop it at the start of a boss phase and unload from inside it. Its effects linger two seconds after you leave, which is enough to reposition mid-cast.

name: Manifest Weapon
stats: Minions from this skill have 1% increased Attack Speed per 3 of your Dexterity
Minions from this skill have 1% increased Damage per 1 of your Strength
description: Manifest a copy of your main hand Melee Martial Weapon as an immortal Companion to fight by your side. In addition to its standard Strikes, the Manifested Weapon gains an additional Attack depending on its weapon type.
skillStats: Minions from this skill have 1% increased Attack Speed per 3 of your Dexterity
Minions from this skill have 1% increased Damage per 1 of your Strength

beginner.whatItIs: A minion skill that copies your main hand melee weapon into an immortal companion, which fights with its own strikes plus one extra attack based on the weapon type.
beginner.whyItMatters: The minion scales off your Strength and Dexterity rather than minion gear, so an attack character gets a permanent extra body without building for minions.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Run it on any melee build with spirit to spare. Upgrading your own weapon upgrades the companion at the same time.

name: Mantra of Destruction
stats: This Skill loses Combo if it generates no Combo for 8 seconds
Empowered Attack gains (50-69)% of Damage as Chaos
Buff duration is up to 8 seconds, or until your next Attack
Purple Flames of Chayula Duration is 20 seconds
description:
Build Combo by successfully Striking Enemies with other skills. After reaching maximum Combo, use this skill to Empower your next Quarterstaff Attack, causing it to deal additional Chaos damage. Each kill with the Empowered Attack grants
Purple Flames of Chayula for a duration.
skillStats: This Skill loses Combo if it generates no Combo for 8 seconds
Empowered Attack gains (50-69)% of Damage as Chaos
Buff duration is up to 8 seconds, or until your next Attack
Purple Flames of Chayula Duration is 20 seconds

beginner.whatItIs: A quarterstaff buff gated behind 8 Combo, which you build by striking enemies. Spending it empowers your next quarterstaff attack to gain 50% to 69% of damage as chaos, and kills with that attack grant Purple Flames of Chayula for twenty seconds.
beginner.whyItMatters: It converts a rhythm you build during trash clearing into one large empowered swing when it counts.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Build combo on a pack, then release into a rare or boss. Combo drains if you go eight seconds without generating any, so do not walk far before spending it.

name: Maul
stats: +0.3 seconds to base use time when Shapeshifting
description: Shapeshift into a Bear and rake enemies with your claws, generating Rage on Hit.
skillStats: +0.3 seconds to base use time when Shapeshifting

beginner.whatItIs: A bear shapeshift attack that rakes enemies with claws and grants 5 Rage on hit.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is the Rage engine for a bear build, and Rage is what pays for the heavier shapeshift skills.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it on trash to build Rage before you spend it on something bigger. Shapeshifting into bear form adds 0.3 seconds to the first use, so do not open a tight fight with it.

name: Meditate
description: Channel to Recharge Energy Shield and allow that Recharge to Overflow. Channelling ends when you take damage or your Energy Shield is fully Overflowed.

beginner.whatItIs: A channelled spell that recharges energy shield 24% to 100% faster than normal and lets that recharge overflow past your maximum. Channelling ends when you take damage or finish overflowing.
beginner.whyItMatters: It turns downtime into a stored buffer, which is one of the few ways to walk into a fight with more energy shield than your gear grants.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Channel it between packs, never during one, since a single hit cancels it.

name: Mirage Archer
description: While active, dodge rolling will create a Mirage that uses socketed ranged Attacks for a short duration, then vanish.

beginner.whatItIs: A meta gem. Dodge rolling creates a Mirage that uses the ranged attacks socketed in it for about five to six seconds, at 30% less damage, on a ten second cooldown.
beginner.whyItMatters: It gives a ranged character damage that continues while they are moving, which is exactly the time a bow build normally deals none.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Socket your main ranged attack and roll on cooldown. Socketed skills cannot consume charges, so do not put a charge-spending skill in it.

name: Mirage Deadeye
description: While active, firing a ranged Projectile Attack will create a Mirage that uses socketed ranged Attacks for a short duration, then vanish.

beginner.whatItIs: A meta gem. Firing a ranged projectile attack creates a Mirage that uses the socketed ranged attacks for about four to five seconds, at 50% less damage, on a ten second cooldown.
beginner.whyItMatters: Unlike its dodge-triggered counterpart it fires from attacking, so it suits a build that stands and shoots rather than one that kites.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Socket a ranged attack and simply keep shooting. The damage penalty is heavier here, so favour it when the trigger condition fits your playstyle better than a roll does.

name: Mirror of Refraction
stats: A Mirror appears in your Presence every (3.9-2) seconds
Projectiles which shatter Mirrors are copied 7 times
Modifiers to Cooldown Recovery Rate also apply to Mirror appearance frequency
description: Mirrors of Refraction appear in your Presence periodically. Hitting a mirror with a Spell Projectile causes it to shatter, copying the projectiles in a nova around the destroyed mirror. Copied Projectiles may be copied again when colliding with other mirrors.
skillStats: A Mirror appears in your Presence every (3.9-2) seconds
Projectiles which shatter Mirrors are copied 7 times
Modifiers to Cooldown Recovery Rate also apply to Mirror appearance frequency

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent skill that spawns up to four mirrors in your Presence, one every two to four seconds. Hitting a mirror with a spell projectile shatters it and copies the projectile seven times in a nova.
beginner.whyItMatters: One projectile spell becomes a spray, and copies can shatter other mirrors and be copied again, which compounds sharply in a small room.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it on a projectile spell build and aim through the mirrors rather than at enemies. Mirrors last eight seconds, so it rewards fighting in one spot.

name: Molten Blast
stats: Converts 60% of Physical damage to Fire damage
While Dual Wielding, fires twice as many Projectiles with 15% less attack speed
description: Gouge molten rock from the ground and fling it at the target. The Projectile explodes on collision, damaging enemies and scattering shrapnel in a cone behind it.
skillStats: Converts 60% of Physical damage to Fire damage
While Dual Wielding, fires twice as many Projectiles with 15% less attack speed

beginner.whatItIs: A mace attack that flings molten rock which explodes in a 1.6 metre area and scatters shrapnel in a cone behind the impact, converting 60% of physical damage to fire.
beginner.whyItMatters: It gives a melee mace character a real ranged option with 200% more flammability magnitude and doubled ignite duration attached.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Throw it at the front of a group so the shrapnel cone covers the rest. Dual wielding fires twice as many projectiles at 15% less attack speed, which is usually worth it against packs.

name: Molten Crash
stats: +0.55 seconds to Total Attack Time, plus up to +0.3 seconds based on distance travelled
Consumes 10 Rage on Landing to create 1 additional Fissure
description: Shapeshift into a burning monstrosity and leap through the air to crash down upon the earth, Slamming twice and creating Molten Fissures. Consumes Rage to create additional Molten Fissures.
skillStats: +0.55 seconds to Total Attack Time, plus up to +0.3 seconds based on distance travelled
Consumes 10 Rage on Landing to create 1 additional Fissure

beginner.whatItIs: A bear shapeshift leap that lands with two slams in a 2 metre area and creates Molten Fissures, plus one extra fissure per 10 Rage consumed on landing.
beginner.whyItMatters: It converts stored Rage directly into lingering ground damage, so a Rage-heavy bear build lands with far more than the base skill shows.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Leap in at high Rage into a group that will stay in the fissures. It adds over half a second to your attack time plus travel, so it is an opener rather than a reaction.

name: Molten Shower
stats: Converts 80% of Physical damage to Fire damage
This Attack is Triggered by Brutus' Lead Sprinkler
description: Fires molten Projectiles from the enemy hit, which will explode when they land nearby, dealing Attack damage in an area.
skillStats: Converts 80% of Physical damage to Fire damage
This Attack is Triggered by Brutus' Lead Sprinkler

beginner.whatItIs: A triggered attack that fires four molten projectiles out of an enemy you hit, each exploding in a 1 metre area for attack damage converted 80% to fire.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is triggered by a specific unique item rather than pressed, so it is damage attached to your gear rather than to your bar.
beginner.whenToUseIt: It comes with Brutus' Lead Sprinkler and fires on its own. Treat it as a reason to consider that weapon, not as a skill you slot.

name: Moment of Vulnerability
stats: 10 second delay before enemy can be affected again
(60-98)% of damage dealt to temporal visages is also dealt to the original targets
description: Send out a temporal Nova to take advantage of enemies' moment of vulnerability. Hitting enemies that are Primed for Stun, Electrocution, or Freeze causes a visage of them to appear, lasting as long as the original target would have been affected by the form of Immobilisation used to create the visage. A portion of the damage dealt to visages is also dealt to the original.
skillStats: 10 second delay before enemy can be affected again
(60-98)% of damage dealt to temporal visages is also dealt to the original targets

beginner.whatItIs: A spell nova with a 4 metre radius. Hitting enemies that are primed for stun, electrocution or freeze spawns a temporal visage of them, and 60% to 98% of damage dealt to the visage is also dealt to the original.
beginner.whyItMatters: It effectively duplicates a target so your damage lands on both copies, which is a large multiplier on a single tough enemy.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it the moment a boss is primed for an immobilisation. There is a ten second lockout per enemy, so it is a once-per-window tool rather than a spam skill.

name: Mortar Cannon
stats: Totem gains +(0-75)% to all Elemental Resistances
Supported Grenade Skills have 100% increased Cooldown Recovery Rate
Supported Skills have 50% less Attack Speed
Supported Grenade Skills deal 50% less Damage
description: Raise a cannon Ballista Totem which uses socketed Grenade Skills, with significantly improved Cooldown Recovery Rate.
skillStats: Totem gains +(0-75)% to all Elemental Resistances
Supported Grenade Skills have 100% increased Cooldown Recovery Rate
Supported Skills have 50% less Attack Speed
Supported Grenade Skills deal 50% less Damage

beginner.whatItIs: A meta gem that raises a cannon ballista totem using the grenade skills socketed in it, with 100% increased cooldown recovery rate, at the cost of 50% less attack speed and 50% less grenade damage.
beginner.whyItMatters: It trades damage per grenade for far more grenades thrown, which suits grenades whose value is in their effect rather than their hit.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Socket a utility grenade whose cooldown normally limits you. The totem lasts eight seconds and only one can be up, so re-place it as fights move.

name: Navira, the Last Mirage
stats: Triggers Navira's Calming when Commanded to use a Skill, granting nearby Allies (10-67)% increased
description: Summon Navira, an invulnerable Water Djinn Minion to do your bidding. Navira will only act when you Command her to do so, bestowing restorative blessings upon you and your Allies with her Spells.
skillStats: Triggers Navira's Calming when Commanded to use a Skill, granting nearby Allies (10-67)% increased

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent minion summoning Navira, an invulnerable Water Djinn who acts only on your Command. Commanding her also triggers Navira's Calming, granting nearby allies 10% to 67% increased mana regeneration for four seconds.
beginner.whyItMatters: She is a support body that cannot be killed, so the party buff never drops because a minion died.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Take her on a build or a party that runs short on mana. She is silent until Commanded, so she is wasted if you never press her skills.

name: Navira's Fracturing
description: A Command skill that has Navira deal cold damage in an area at the target point.

beginner.whatItIs: A Command skill that has Navira deal cold damage in an area at the target point.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is Navira's direct damage option, so a support-focused djinn still contributes something offensive when you need it.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Command it at a group that has bunched together. Because it is a cold area hit rather than a lasting effect, it wants enemies standing close right now, not enemies on their way in.

name: Navira's Oasis
description: A Command skill that has Navira create a lasting area effect at the target point.

beginner.whatItIs: A Command skill that has Navira create a lasting area effect at the target point.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is the ground-holding half of her kit, useful when a fight has a spot the party must stand in.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Place it where you intend to hold, ahead of the moment you need it, since it takes effect over a duration rather than instantly.

name: Navira's Well
description: A Command skill that has Navira produce a lasting effect on you or a target for a duration, with no area component.

beginner.whatItIs: A Command skill that has Navira produce a lasting effect on you or a target for a duration, with no area component.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is her single-target sustain tool, which is what you reach for when the party is spread out and an area effect would miss most of it.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it on whoever is taking pressure rather than on the group. Because it runs on a duration, refresh it before it lapses instead of after.

name: Oil Barrage
stats: Channelling ends after one group of Projectiles
Oil Slows enemy movement speed by 20%
description: Shapeshift into a Wyvern and spit Oil at enemies, creating Oil Ground where the Projectiles land. Consumes Power Charges if possible to instead Channel a sustained barrage of electrified Oil that does not create Oil Ground. Projectiles are fired in sequence, allowing multiple Projectiles to Hit the same target.
skillStats: Channelling ends after one group of Projectiles
Oil Slows enemy movement speed by 20%

beginner.whatItIs: A wyvern shapeshift attack spitting three oil projectiles that create oil ground for six seconds, slowing enemies by 20% and applying 20% elemental exposure.
beginner.whyItMatters: The exposure lowers all three elemental resistances, so it makes every elemental hit that follows land harder.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Spit it into a group before your elemental damage arrives. Spending Power Charges switches it to a channelled electrified barrage that skips the oil ground, so choose based on whether you want the ground or the damage.

name: Oil Grenade
stats: Damage and Oil spray radius is (2-2.6) metres
Oil Slows enemy movement speed by 40%
description: Fire a bouncing Grenade that bursts in a spray of Oil when the fuse expires or when it impacts an Enemy, dealing minimal damage but covering the ground and nearby enemies in Oil. Oil created this way can be Ignited by Detonator Skills or Ignited Ground.
skillStats: Damage and Oil spray radius is (2-2.6) metres
Oil Slows enemy movement speed by 40%

beginner.whatItIs: A crossbow grenade that bursts after 1.6 seconds into a spray of oil, dealing almost no damage but slowing enemies 40% and applying 20% elemental exposure for six seconds.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is pure setup: the slow and the exposure are the point, and the oil it leaves can be ignited by a detonator or by ignited ground.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Throw it first, then bring the fire. Judging it on its own damage number will make you drop a good utility skill.

name: Orb of Storms
stats: Fires a bolt every 4 seconds, and when you cast a Spell near the Orb
description: Create an Orb of electricity that fires Chaining Lightning bolts at nearby enemies. The Orb leaves behind a Lightning Infusion Remnant when it expires.
skillStats: Fires a bolt every 4 seconds, and when you cast a Spell near the Orb

beginner.whatItIs: A spell creating an orb with a 3.6 metre radius that fires chaining lightning bolts every four seconds and whenever you cast a spell near it, for twelve seconds or six bolts.
beginner.whyItMatters: It fires on your casts, so a caster gets a second source of hits that scales with how fast they are already casting, and it leaves a Lightning Infusion Remnant when it expires.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Drop it where you plan to stand and keep casting inside its radius. Only one can be active, so re-place it as you move.

name: Overwhelming Presence
stats: Enemies in your Presence have (15-24)% reduced
Enemies in your Presence have (15-25)% reduced Stun Threshold
description: While active, emits an Aura that makes enemies in your Presence easier to Stun and inflict Elemental Ailments upon.
skillStats: Enemies in your Presence have (15-24)% reduced
Enemies in your Presence have (15-25)% reduced Stun Threshold

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent aura that reduces the stun threshold of enemies in your Presence by 15% to 25% and their elemental ailment threshold by 15% to 24%.
beginner.whyItMatters: It makes your stuns and ailments land sooner without changing anything about your own damage, which is a large effect on a build that already wants them.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Run it on a stun or ailment build. It does nothing for a character that relies on raw damage alone.

name: Pain Offering
stats: Aura grants Minions (20-29)% increased Attack and Cast Speed
description: Skewer a Skeleton on a bone spike to send nearby Minions into a frenzy as long as the spike remains, making their skills faster and harder hitting. The bone spike is itself a Minion. If it dies, the effect ends immediately.
skillStats: Aura grants Minions (20-29)% increased Attack and Cast Speed

beginner.whatItIs: A minion buff. You skewer a skeleton on a bone spike for six seconds, granting minions in a 6 metre radius 20% to 29% increased attack and cast speed and 20% to 58% increased damage.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is a large minion damage window bought by sacrificing one of your own summons, so it costs you a body to make the rest hit harder.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Cast it as a boss fight opens and your minions are already engaged. The spike is itself a minion, so if it dies the buff ends immediately.

name: Parry
stats: Can Block Damage from enemies within 1 metre
Can Block Projectile Damage from enemies within 1.5 metres
Parried Debuff makes targets take 50% more Attack Damage
3 to 4 Added Physical Damage per 5 Evasion Rating on Buckler
description: Ready your Buckler to parry the next Hit you would take, Blocking the Hit and retaliating with a quick sweep that leaves enemies off balance, causing them to take massively increased Attack damage for a short duration. Parrying causes you to accumulate Heavy Stun buildup. You cannot Evade a Hit you could parry, but Evasion instead grants an equal chance to avoid this Heavy Stun buildup.
skillStats: Can Block Damage from enemies within 1 metre
Can Block Projectile Damage from enemies within 1.5 metres
Parried Debuff makes targets take 50% more Attack Damage
3 to 4 Added Physical Damage per 5 Evasion Rating on Buckler

beginner.whatItIs: A buckler skill that readies you to block the next hit within one metre, or 1.5 metres for projectiles, retaliating with a sweep that leaves enemies taking 50% more attack damage for two seconds.
beginner.whyItMatters: It converts a defensive read into an offensive window, and it adds physical damage scaled off the evasion rating on your buckler.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Time it against a telegraphed hit, then follow up during the Parried window. Parrying builds heavy stun on you, so you cannot chain it endlessly.

name: Perfect Strike
stats: Converts 40% of Physical damage to Fire damage
While Dual Wielding, both weapons hit with 30% less damage
description: Channel to charge up your weapon with Fire. Releasing with Perfect Timing will create a damaging wave of intense Fire.
skillStats: Converts 40% of Physical damage to Fire damage
While Dual Wielding, both weapons hit with 30% less damage

beginner.whatItIs: A channelled mace strike that charges your weapon with fire. Releasing on Perfect Timing creates a wave of intense fire, converting 40% of physical damage to fire.
beginner.whyItMatters: The damage lives in the timing rather than the button, so it rewards learning the release window instead of raising attack speed.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it on a target that will hold still long enough to charge. Dual wielding costs 30% damage on both weapons, so it favours a two-hander.

name: Permafrost Bolts
stats: Converts 80% of Physical Damage to Cold Damage
Bolts shatter on impact, dealing Damage in a 2.7 metre cone
description: Load your Crossbow with icy bolts that fragment in flight, damaging enemies on hit and in a small cone behind their final target. The icy coating on the bolts makes them extremely potent at Freezing enemies. These fragments can Merge.
skillStats: Converts 80% of Physical Damage to Cold Damage
Bolts shatter on impact, dealing Damage in a 2.7 metre cone

beginner.whatItIs: A crossbow ammunition skill firing icy bolts that fragment into ten pieces on impact, damaging a 2.7 metre cone behind the target with 200% to 504% more freeze buildup.
beginner.whyItMatters: That freeze buildup multiplier is the whole point: it freezes packs far faster than the base damage suggests.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Fire it into the front of a group to freeze the line. The fragments can merge, so a tight pack takes larger combined hits.

name: Phantasmal Arrow
stats: Converts 20% of Physical damage to Fire damage
description: Fires an arrow that embeds where it lands for a short duration. At the end of the duration, the arrow explodes in spectral flame, turning it to ashes and damaging enemies, with a high chance to Ignite. Igniting any enemy with the Explosion also applies Ignite to enemies within range.
skillStats: Converts 20% of Physical damage to Fire damage

beginner.whatItIs: A bow attack whose arrow sticks where it lands for 1.5 seconds, then explodes in spectral flame with a high chance to ignite, spreading that ignite to enemies in range.
beginner.whyItMatters: The delay means it damages the pack that arrives after you shoot, so it rewards firing ahead of enemy movement.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Plant it in the path of an approaching group rather than on an enemy standing still. Only 20% of its physical damage converts to fire, so most of the fire value is in the ignite spread.

name: Pinnacle of Power
stats: Buff duration is 5 seconds per Power Charge Consumed
15% more Elemental Damage per Power Charge Consumed
Buff causes all Elemental Damage to Contribute to Flammability and Ignite Magnitudes, Shock chance, and Freeze buildup
description: Consume all Power Charges to master the elements, gaining Elemental Damage and the ability to apply Elemental Ailments with other damage types. Can only be used while you have maximum Power Charges.
skillStats: Buff duration is 5 seconds per Power Charge Consumed
15% more Elemental Damage per Power Charge Consumed
Buff causes all Elemental Damage to Contribute to Flammability and Ignite Magnitudes, Shock chance, and Freeze buildup

beginner.whatItIs: A buff usable only at maximum Power Charges. It spends them all for 15% more elemental damage per charge and lets all your elemental damage contribute to ignite, shock and freeze, lasting five seconds per charge spent.
beginner.whyItMatters: It removes the usual rule that only fire causes ignite and only cold causes freeze, so a mixed elemental build inflicts everything at once.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Fill your charges before a boss and spend them all at the start of your burst. It cannot be used at partial charges, so plan generation around it.

name: Plague Bearer
stats: Stores 4% of Expected Poison damage, up to (43-15257)
Deals Physical damage equal to the stored Poison
description: While active, stores a portion of the Poison Damage you deal. Using this Skill unleashes the stored Poison to damage and Poison enemies around you.
skillStats: Stores 4% of Expected Poison damage, up to (43-15257)
Deals Physical damage equal to the stored Poison

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent buff that banks 4% of the poison damage you deal, then releases the stored total as physical damage and poison to everything around you when you press it.
beginner.whyItMatters: It converts poison, which is slow by nature, into a burst you can time, which is what poison builds normally lack.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Fill it clearing trash, then unload it on a rare or boss. The store has a cap, so release it rather than letting it sit full.

name: Plasma Blast
stats: Converts 80% of Physical Damage to Lightning Damage
description: Load your Crossbow with unstable bolts that require a lengthy charging period to fire but deal devastating damage, Pierce through enemies, and explode upon hitting terrain. Additional Projectiles are fired in a spread, unlike other Crossbow Skills.
skillStats: Converts 80% of Physical Damage to Lightning Damage

beginner.whatItIs: A crossbow skill loading one bolt per clip that takes two extra seconds to fire but pierces everything, explodes on terrain, and converts 80% of physical damage to lightning with 50% more shock magnitude.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is one of the heaviest single crossbow shots, trading all of your rate of fire for one line of damage through a whole pack.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Fire it down a corridor of lined-up enemies or into a boss. Extra projectiles fire in a spread rather than sequentially, unlike most crossbow skills.

name: Poisonburst Arrow
description: Fire a virulent arrow that creates a burst of Poison on hit, affecting all enemies in an area.

beginner.whatItIs: A bow attack whose arrow bursts into poison on hit, affecting every enemy in the area.
beginner.whyItMatters: It applies poison to a whole group from one shot, which is what makes poison viable as a clearing damage type rather than a single-target one.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Open on a pack with it, then let the poison run while you do something else. It is a low level gem, so it is a natural first chaos bow skill.

name: Pounce
stats: Mark a target, causing it to take increased damage based on how many of the target's enemies are near to it. If the target dies, the Mark will Activate to Trigger the Summon Wolf skill and Consume the Mark.
Marked target takes 3% increased damage for each of its enemies within 6 metres of it, up to 45%
Marked target takes (0.05-1)% increased damage for each of its enemies within 6 metres of it, up to (0.75-15)%
This skill is Triggered when Predator's Mark Activates to Summon a Wolf Minion that follows you as long as it lives.
Summons +1 Wolf if Marked target is Unique
description: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and leap to a target location, damaging enemies in an area around where you land. Predator's Mark will be Triggered targeting the highest Rarity enemy Hit, or if a Mark gem is socketed into this Skill, that Mark will be Triggered instead. Using this Skill allows any Wolf Minions you have to leap immediately.
skillStats: Mark a target, causing it to take increased damage based on how many of the target's enemies are near to it. If the target dies, the Mark will Activate to Trigger the Summon Wolf skill and Consume the Mark.
Marked target takes 3% increased damage for each of its enemies within 6 metres of it, up to 45%
Marked target takes (0.05-1)% increased damage for each of its enemies within 6 metres of it, up to (0.75-15)%
This skill is Triggered when Predator's Mark Activates to Summon a Wolf Minion that follows you as long as it lives.
Summons +1 Wolf if Marked target is Unique

beginner.whatItIs: A werewolf meta gem that leaps to a target location, damages a 2 metre area, and triggers Predator's Mark on the highest rarity enemy hit, or a Mark socketed in it instead. Wolves you own leap with you.
beginner.whyItMatters: It bundles movement, area damage, marking and a wolf summon into one press, since Predator's Mark summons a wolf when the marked target dies.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Open packs with it so the mark lands on the rare rather than on trash. The marked target takes up to 45% increased damage based on how many of its allies are nearby, so it pays off best in dense groups.

name: Power Siphon
stats: (0-76)% chance to grant an additional Power Charge on Cull
description: Attempt to rip the lifeforce from an enemy. Enemies within Culling range will be highlighted and instantly killed on Hit, granting a Power Charge. Can only target Enemies in Culling range.
skillStats: (0-76)% chance to grant an additional Power Charge on Cull

beginner.whatItIs: A spell that can only target enemies already inside culling range. It kills them instantly on hit and grants a Power Charge, with a chance for a second.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is charge generation disguised as a kill skill, and it highlights valid targets so you never guess whether it will work.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Press it on the weakened stragglers at the end of a pack. It is not a damage skill, so pointing it at a healthy enemy does nothing.

name: Powered by Verisium
description: Spends Ward to generate Verisium Infusions, which can be used in place of any Elemental Infusions.

beginner.whatItIs: A spell that spends Ward to generate one to four Verisium Infusions, which stand in for any elemental infusion.
beginner.whyItMatters: It removes the usual requirement to apply a specific element before a skill that consumes an infusion, at the cost of a defensive pool.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it on a build with several infusion-consuming skills of different elements. If you only run one element, applying that element directly is cheaper.

name: Primal Bounty
stats: Empowered Skills have (30-68)% increased Projectile speed
This Skill is Triggered by consuming a Primal Owl Feather when you Dodge Roll
description: Empowers the next Projectile Skill you use, causing it to create additional Projectiles and fly faster.
skillStats: Empowered Skills have (30-68)% increased Projectile speed
This Skill is Triggered by consuming a Primal Owl Feather when you Dodge Roll

beginner.whatItIs: A triggered buff that empowers your next projectile skill to fire two additional projectiles at 30% to 68% increased projectile speed. It fires when you dodge roll while carrying a Primal Owl Feather.
beginner.whyItMatters: It rewards rolling with extra projectiles, so a ranged character gets paid for the defensive action instead of losing damage to it.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Roll just before your heaviest projectile skill rather than after it, so the buff lands on the shot that matters.

name: Primal Strikes
stats: Converts 40% of Physical damage to Lightning damage
description: Perform a Lightning-charged stab that can be chained into a combination of up to three attacks. The first two attacks conjure a charging Wildwood spirit if they Hit a Shocked enemy and refresh Shock duration. The third attack is a large swipe that inflicts Elemental Exposure, and can Consume Shock to conjure a stampede of spirits.
skillStats: Converts 40% of Physical damage to Lightning damage

beginner.whatItIs: A spear combination of up to three lightning strikes. The first two conjure a charging Wildwood spirit if they hit a shocked enemy and refresh shock; the third is a wide swipe that inflicts elemental exposure and can consume shock to summon a stampede.
beginner.whyItMatters: The whole sequence is written around shock, so a spear build that shocks turns each combo into extra bodies and exposure on the target.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Shock first, then commit to the full three-hit chain. Cutting it short after the second strike loses the exposure and the stampede.

name: Profane Ritual
stats: Modifiers to Spell Damage apply to Debuff's Damage over Time
description: Mark a Corpse with a profane rune, dealing Chaos damage over time to nearby enemies. When the ritual is complete the Corpse is consumed and you gain a Power Charge.
skillStats: Modifiers to Spell Damage apply to Debuff's Damage over Time

beginner.whatItIs: A spell that marks a corpse with a rune dealing chaos damage over time in a 2.2 metre radius for two seconds. When it finishes, the corpse is consumed and you gain a Power Charge.
beginner.whyItMatters: It converts battlefield corpses into charges, which is charge generation that costs you nothing but a cast.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Run up to five rituals at once on a corpse-rich fight. It needs corpses, so it produces nothing against enemies that leave none.

name: Punch
description: Perform an Unarmed Strike.

beginner.whatItIs: The default unarmed strike, hitting one enemy with a small area around the impact.
beginner.whyItMatters: It means a character with no weapon equipped still has an attack, which matters mostly for builds that deliberately fight unarmed.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it when you have no weapon or when an unarmed build wants a basic hit. Any real weapon skill outperforms it.

name: Purity of Fire
description: Emit an Aura that boosts the Fire Resistance of you and Allies in your Presence.

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent aura granting you and allies in your Presence 22% to 41% fire resistance.
beginner.whyItMatters: Resistances are the flat wall between you and elemental damage, and an aura fills the gap that gear has not.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Run it before a fire-heavy area or boss. Swap it for a damage aura once your fire resistance is capped by gear.

name: Purity of Ice
description: Emit an Aura that boosts the Cold Resistance of you and Allies in your Presence.

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent aura granting you and allies in your Presence 22% to 41% cold resistance.
beginner.whyItMatters: Cold damage often comes with freezes attached, so the resistance reduces both the hit and how quickly the freeze builds.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Reserve it when cold is the threat in front of you. Like the other purity auras it is a swap, not a permanent fixture.

name: Purity of Lightning
description: Emit an Aura that boosts the Lightning Resistance of you and Allies in your Presence.

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent aura granting you and allies in your Presence 22% to 41% lightning resistance.
beginner.whyItMatters: Lightning hits tend to arrive in large spikes, so raising the resistance changes whether a hit is survivable rather than merely uncomfortable.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Turn it on for lightning bosses and areas. Reserving all three purities at once is usually more spirit than a build can spare.

name: Quarterstaff Strike
description: Strike with your Quarterstaff.

beginner.whatItIs: The default quarterstaff attack, striking one enemy with a small area around the hit.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is the fallback that guarantees a quarterstaff always has something to press.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it at the very start of a quarterstaff character until a real skill gem is available.

name: Raging Spirits
stats: Minions from this skill convert 70% of Physical Damage to Fire Damage
Fire Area Spells summon a Spirit per 1.5 metres of radius
Projectiles from Fire Spells summon a Spirit on hit
Maximum 2 Spirits summoned per Spell cast
description: While active, Fire Spells you use yourself will also summon Raging Spirits, which are short-lived flaming skulls that rush at nearby enemies and rapidly Attack them, ignoring commands. Enemies will not directly engage these Minions, and can pass through them.
skillStats: Minions from this skill convert 70% of Physical Damage to Fire Damage
Fire Area Spells summon a Spirit per 1.5 metres of radius
Projectiles from Fire Spells summon a Spirit on hit

beginner.whyItMatters: It attacks continuously without you, and it works while you are shapeshifted, which most attack skills do not.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Place it where enemies gather and leave it working while you fight elsewhere. Pair it with a skill that lays jagged ground so its slams have something to set off.

beginner.whyItMatters: It rolls a gap closer and a multi-hit combo into one button, with a freeze payoff attached for a cold build.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it to reach a frozen target so the ice fragments trigger. Against unfrozen enemies you are only getting the claw damage.

beginner.whenToUseIt: Plant it before a boss phase or on the far side of a pack. Only one totem can be up, so re-place rather than stacking.

beginner.whenToUseIt: Fire it into a scattered pack where a fixed area skill would waste most of its coverage. It reloads 30% more slowly, so pick your moments.

beginner.whyItMatters: It rewards a caster for standing and spending, turning mana expenditure into a compounding damage buff.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Drop it at the start of a boss and cast from inside it. Its full value takes several seconds of casting to reach, so it is wasted on trash.

beginner.whyItMatters: It is how an elemental build funds infusion-consuming skills without a dedicated generator.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Run it alongside skills that consume infusions. On a build with no infusion consumer, the remnants do nothing for you.

beginner.whyItMatters: It converts a shock into both burst damage and charge generation, so a shock build stops needing a separate charge skill.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it on shocked targets only, since the shockwave and the charge both depend on consuming the shock. It cannot shock by itself.

beginner.whyItMatters: It turns a minion that was about to die anyway into a bomb, which is how a summoner gets burst out of attrition.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Command the detonation when a tanky minion is already low. It can only target minions below a life threshold, so a healthy army gives it nothing to blow up.

name: Skeletal Brute

beginner.whatItIs: A minion skill summoning hard-hitting reviving skeletons that can stun primed enemies and, on Command, warcry to intimidate nearby enemies and consume freeze for area damage.
beginner.whyItMatters: It gives a summoner stun and intimidate pressure, which minions otherwise rarely provide.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Command the warcry when enemies around your minions are frozen, since the freeze is what the damage comes from.

name: Skeletal Cleric

beginner.whatItIs: A minion skill summoning reviving skeletons that heal your other minions and bring fallen skeletons back.
beginner.whyItMatters: It keeps an army alive without you spending casts on resummoning, which is most of the effort in playing a summoner.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Add clerics once your army is large enough that losing bodies is costing you damage. On a two-minion build they have little to heal.

beginner.whyItMatters: Cutting incoming hit damage by 40% across the army is a larger swing than any single minion's damage, and the frozen status feeds cold payoff effects.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Command it as your minions engage a dangerous pack. The twelve second cooldown means it is a fight-opener, not a reaction.

beginner.whyItMatters: It is the damage-forward skeleton, giving a summoner a button that raises the army's output rather than its survival.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Enrage them as a boss fight begins so they build Rage during it. Trash usually dies before the ramp matters.

name: Skeletal Sniper

beginner.whatItIs: A minion skill summoning long-ranged reviving skeletons that fire a gas arrow on Command.
beginner.whyItMatters: They attack from the back, so they survive fights that kill melee minions, and the gas arrow adds an area effect the rest of the army lacks.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Take them when your melee minions are dying faster than they revive. Their Command needs something to ignite the gas to get full value.

beginner.whyItMatters: It is the one minion Command that gets stronger the worse your fight is going, since it needs dead skeletons to strike.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Press it after your front line has taken losses, not before. With no fallen skeletons in the area it has nothing to target.

beginner.whyItMatters: The free first two mean any character can carry a couple of bodies to soak hits without committing spirit to a summoner build.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Take it early as cheap frontline, and as the base of a skeleton army later. It is the plainest skeleton, so specialists outperform it once spirit allows.

beginner.whyItMatters: It has no sockets and needs no button, so it is free area damage and armour breaking bolted onto a stun build.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Run it on any build that heavy stuns regularly. It never fires for a character that cannot heavy stun.

beginner.whenToUseIt: Apply an ailment widely, then snap the strongest target so the spread reaches the most enemies. Cast on a Frostbolt it makes a much larger cold blast.

beginner.whenToUseIt: Take it against frozen bosses where you have room to charge. Attack speed modifiers also raise its cost, so faster is not automatically better here.

beginner.whenToUseIt: Mark a target right before your crit burst. Only one target can be marked, so use it on the enemy you intend to kill.

beginner.whenToUseIt: Drop it in the middle of a group and fight around it. Only one orb can exist, so move it rather than stacking it.

beginner.whatItIs: A spell creating a 3 metre storm for eight seconds that pulls enemies in and deals physical damage over time. Overlapping an elemental ground surface makes the tornado absorb that surface's debuff and deal extra damage of that element.
beginner.whyItMatters: The pull gathers a scattered pack into one place, which makes every other area skill you have land better.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Place it over ground another skill has set on fire, frozen or shocked so it absorbs the element. Only one tornado can exist at a time.

name: Tornado Shot
description: Fire a skyward shot that whips up a Tornado where it lands, dealing Physical damage over time and Hindering enemies standing in it. Arrows, thrown Spears and Crossbow bolts fired at the Tornado are sucked into it, causing the Tornado to spit out a ring of copied Projectiles. Copied Projectiles cannot be copied again, even by further Tornados.

beginner.whatItIs: A bow attack whipping up a tornado where the arrow lands, dealing physical damage over time and hindering enemies inside. Arrows, thrown spears and bolts fired into it are copied into a ring of projectiles.
beginner.whyItMatters: It turns any projectile skill you own into a spray, which is usually worth more than the tornado's own damage.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Plant a tornado between you and the enemy, then fire your main projectile skill through it. Copied projectiles cannot be copied again, so a second tornado adds nothing to the same shot.

Pustules will Detonate after a duration or when enough Poison has been applied, dealing more damage based on the stored Poison damage and applying Poison in an area around it.
skillStats: Each enemy can have up to 1 Pustule attached
