beginner.whatItIs: A 3 metre bloom on the ground lasting eight seconds. Inside it your skills cost 25% more, you regenerate life, and your projectile attacks attach a Toxic Pustule to enemies. Pustules detonate after six seconds or once enough poison has been stored, dealing more damage the more poison they hold.
beginner.whyItMatters: It converts poison you apply into stored explosions rather than slow ticks, with stored poison granting up to 300% more explosion damage.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Stand in the bloom and poison a group so the pustules fill before they detonate. Fighting outside the bloom attaches nothing at all.

name: Toxic Growth
stats: Stored Poison adds up to 1.5 metres to base explosion radius
Stored Poison grants up to 300% more explosion Damage
description: Fire a rain of Toxic Pustules into the air. The Pustules deal damage on impact, then Detonate after a delay. They can also be Poisoned, causing them to Detonate faster and more violently.
skillStats: Stored Poison adds up to 1.5 metres to base explosion radius
Stored Poison grants up to 300% more explosion Damage

beginner.whatItIs: A bow attack raining five Toxic Pustules that damage on impact and detonate after a delay. Poisoning them makes them detonate faster and harder, with up to 300% more explosion damage and 1.5 metres of extra radius.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is a delayed area bomb whose size you control by how much poison you feed it, rather than by the shot itself.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Fire the pustules into a pack, then poison them before the fifteen second fuse runs out. Only five can be active.

name: Trail of Caltrops
stats: Maims and deal Attack area damage when triggered by an Enemy. Caltrops are destroyed when triggered, and a maximum of 20 Caltrops can be active at once.
Increases and reduction to Thorns Damage apply to Hit Damage with this skill

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent buff scattering three caltrops each time you dodge, up to twenty active for eight seconds. An enemy that steps on one takes area attack damage and is maimed, destroying the caltrop.
beginner.whyItMatters: It pays you for dodging, and increases to thorns damage apply to its hits, which is a scaling route most attack skills cannot use.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Roll through a chasing pack so the caltrops land behind you in their path. Rolling in open ground away from enemies produces nothing.

name: Trinity

description: Become attuned to all Elements building up Fire, Cold and Lightning Affinity based off the highest Elemental Damage type dealt by your Hits. Your Elemental Damage is enhanced the more Affinity of any type you have.
skillStats: (1-6)% more Elemental Damage per 30 Affinity of any type
On dealing Elemental Damage with a Hit, gain (5-13) Affinity of the highest Elemental Damage type and lose 3 Affinity of the other types

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent buff building Fire, Cold and Lightning Affinity. Each hit grants five to thirteen Affinity of its dominant element and removes three Affinity of the other two, and every 30 Affinity you hold grants 1% to 6% more elemental damage.
beginner.whyItMatters: Because you lose the other types every hit, it rewards a build that spreads damage across all three elements and punishes one that only uses one.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Run it on a genuinely mixed elemental build. A single-element character will hold one affinity and bleed the other two dry.

name: Triskelion Cascade

description: Tap into the power of the Triskelion Flame to Empower the next Cascadable Spell you cast. The Empowered Spell becomes centred on your location, and Cascades to six areas around you in a Triskelion pattern.
skillStats: (800-300)% of Empowered Skill's cast time is added to this Skill's cooldown
Empowered Skill has (40-31)% less area of effect

beginner.whatItIs: A buff empowering the next cascadable spell you cast to centre on you and cascade into six areas around you in a triskelion pattern, at 31% to 40% less area and 11% to 30% less damage.
beginner.whyItMatters: It trades size and damage per hit for six placements instead of one, which is a straight win against a spread out pack and a loss against a single target.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it for clearing rather than for bosses. Its cooldown scales with the empowered spell's cast time, so pairing it with a very slow spell locks it out for a long while.

name: Twister

If a twister touches a Whirlwind from your other skills, it Consumes the Whirlwind to create additional twisters that deal more damage. Twisters fired at the same time can Hit the same target no more than once every 0.66 seconds

beginner.whatItIs: A spear skill whipping up a twister that drifts forward erratically, blinding and repeatedly hitting enemies inside it for three seconds.
beginner.whyItMatters: Touching one of your own whirlwinds consumes it to create extra twisters and deal 80% more damage per whirlwind stage, so it compounds with the other wind spear skills.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Fire it through your own whirlwinds and across elemental ground, which grants twisters 50% of their damage as that element. Fired into empty space it is only a small hit.

name: Unbound Avatar

description: Gain Unbound Fury by inflicting Elemental Ailments with Hits on enemies. Once you reach maximum Unbound Fury, consume it to become Unbound for a duration, vastly augmenting your Elemental prowess.
skillStats: Gain Unbound Fury when you inflict an Elemental Ailment with a Hit on an Enemy

40% more Elemental Ailment Buildup while Unbound

beginner.whatItIs: A buff building Unbound Fury when you inflict elemental ailments with hits, up to a hundred. Spending it makes you Unbound for eight to ten seconds, with 40% more elemental damage, 80% more chance to inflict ailments and 40% more ailment buildup.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is a large burst window earned by doing what an elemental build already does, and it feeds itself since the ailment bonuses make the next fill faster.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Arrive at a boss with Fury full and spend it immediately. You cannot gain Fury while Unbound, so the meter only refills after it ends.

name: Unearth
stats: Reviving Minions can only create one Bone Construct per death
description: Raise spikes of bone from the earth in front of you, damaging enemies. The bones of Corpses and dead Reviving Minions in the area are ripped out and reassembled into short-lived Bone Construct Minions that fight for you. Larger Corpses create more than one Bone Construct.
skillStats: Reviving Minions can only create one Bone Construct per death

beginner.whatItIs: A spell raising bone spikes in a 6 metre cone for physical damage. Corpses and dead reviving minions in the area are rebuilt into short-lived Bone Constructs, up to twenty, lasting fifteen seconds.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is damage and a temporary army in one cast, which is how a caster fields minions without reserving spirit for them.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Cast it over a corpse-strewn area rather than at a fresh pack. Each reviving minion can only make one construct per death.

name: Unleash
stats: (1200-1010)% of Empowered Skill's cast time is added to this Skill's cooldown
description: Augment yourself with temporal magic for a short duration, Empowering the next Repeatable Spell you cast to Repeat multiple times. Cannot Empower Skills with a Cooldown.
skillStats: (1200-1010)% of Empowered Skill's cast time is added to this Skill's cooldown

beginner.whatItIs: A buff empowering the next repeatable spell you cast to repeat two extra times. It cannot empower skills with a cooldown.
beginner.whyItMatters: Three casts for one press is a straightforward damage multiplier on a single spell, at the cost of a long lockout afterwards.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Save it for your heaviest repeatable spell during a burst. Its cooldown is over ten times the empowered spell's cast time, so pairing it with a slow spell makes it rarely available.

name: Untether
stats: Explodes after enemy is dealt damage equal to 100% of its Ailment Threshold
description: Plant a seed of Abyssal Energy on the enemy's heart. Dealing enough damage to the enemy, or killing it outright, causes their heart to explode, dealing Physical damage in an area.
skillStats: Explodes after enemy is dealt damage equal to 100% of its Ailment Threshold

beginner.whatItIs: A spell planting a seed of abyssal energy in an enemy. Dealing damage equal to its ailment threshold, or killing it, explodes its heart for physical damage in a 2.1 metre radius.
beginner.whyItMatters: Its trigger threshold is half that of the fire version, so it detonates far sooner, and you can hold five seeds at once instead of one.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Seed several enemies inside a pack, then damage them all so the explosions overlap. Seeds only last six seconds, so plant them just before you commit.

name: Valako's Charge
stats: Triggers after you take a total of (17-628) Lightning Hit Damage
description: While active, taking Lightning damage builds up charge on you. Reaching full charge expends all charge to Trigger this skill, creating a Chaining lightning bolt that arcs to nearby enemies.

stats: Triggers after you take a total of (17-628) Lightning Hit Damage

skillStats: Triggers after you take a total of (17-628) Lightning Hit Damage

beginner.whatItIs: A triggered spell that builds charge as you take lightning damage. Reaching full charge fires a chaining lightning bolt at enemies within three metres.
beginner.whyItMatters: It converts damage you are taking into damage you deal, which makes lightning-heavy fights slightly less one-sided.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Run it going into lightning content specifically. Against an enemy that deals no lightning damage it will never trigger.

name: Vaulting Impact
description: Leap forward and Slam the ground, sending out a shockwave. The shockwave applies Broken Stance to Dazed enemies, causing any Hits against those enemies to deal extra damage.

beginner.whatItIs: A quarterstaff leap and slam sending a shockwave through a 2.4 metre area, applying Broken Stance to dazed enemies so all hits against them deal extra damage.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is a gap closer that also sets up a damage-taken debuff, but only on enemies something else has already dazed.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Daze a group first, then leap in. It cannot inflict daze itself, so leading with it against fresh enemies applies no debuff.

name: Vine Arrow
description: Fire an arrow into the air that lands after a short delay, damaging enemies and causing a plant to spring up at the impact location. The plant sprouts vines that latch onto nearby enemies, Slowing their movement speed and dealing Chaos damage over time. The plant can be Poisoned, causing it to deal more damage.

beginner.whatItIs: A bow attack landing after a short delay to raise a plant that latches vines onto nearby enemies, slowing them and dealing chaos damage over time. The plant can be poisoned to deal more damage.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is a slow and a damage-over-time source in one shot, and it keeps working while you fight something else.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Plant one to three of them around a group, then poison them if your build can. It does very little burst, so do not reach for it under pressure.

Single-Attribute Skills grant twice as many maximum Motes

5% increased Mana Regeneration rate per Intelligence Mote

5% increased Mana Regeneration rate per Intelligence Mote

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent barrier gathering a random Mote of Strength, Dexterity or Intelligence every one and a half to two seconds, losing a random one when you are hit. Strength motes give 2% increased maximum life each, Dexterity motes 5% increased armour, evasion and energy shield, Intelligence motes 5% increased life and mana regeneration.
beginner.whyItMatters: Your maximum motes of each type scale with how many of your skills require that attribute, so the skill quietly rewards a focused gem selection.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Run it on a character that avoids hits, since every hit costs a mote. Single-attribute skills grant twice as many maximum motes, which favours a specialised build.

name: Vivid Stampede
stats: Converts 60% of Physical damage to Lightning damage
description: Call upon Spirits of the Stag, sending them leaping forward. Each Stag releases a damaging shockwave each time it lands, and any Stags that travel the maximum possible distance also leave behind Shocked Ground.
skillStats: Converts 60% of Physical damage to Lightning damage

beginner.whatItIs: A triggered attack sending stag spirits leaping forward four times, each landing releasing a shockwave in a 2 metre radius. Stags that travel the full distance leave shocked ground for four seconds.
beginner.whyItMatters: The shocked ground only appears at maximum range, so the skill rewards firing it across open space rather than into something next to you.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Send it down a long approach so the stags complete their leaps. Used point blank you get the shockwaves and none of the ground.

name: Void Illusion
description: While active, creates a short-lived illusory copy of yourself whenever you dodge roll. The copy can be damaged by enemies, and copies that are destroyed by an enemy will cause damaging explosions. Copies created this way have 1 Life.

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent buff creating an illusory copy of you whenever you dodge roll. The copy has one life, lasts two seconds, and explodes in a 3 metre radius for heavy attack damage when an enemy destroys it.
beginner.whyItMatters: With one life the copy dies to anything, which means the explosion is close to guaranteed whenever an enemy is near.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Roll through or beside a pack so the copy is destroyed immediately. Rolling away from enemies leaves it to expire unused.

name: Volatile Dead
stats: Ignites as though dealing (4–146) to (6–218) Fire damage
description: Consume a Corpse to create a volatile core that seeks out enemies and Ignites enemies near it. The core explodes at the end of its duration.
skillStats: Ignites as though dealing (4–146) to (6–218) Fire damage

beginner.whatItIs: A spell consuming a corpse to create a volatile core that seeks enemies, igniting anything within 1.5 metres for five seconds, then explodes in a 2.2 metre radius for fire damage.
beginner.whyItMatters: The core hunts on its own, so the damage finds targets you never aimed at, and it ignites the whole way there.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Cast it where corpses are plentiful and enemies keep arriving. With no corpse available it cannot be used at all.

name: Volcanic Fissure
stats: Converts 80% of Physical damage to Fire damage
While Dual Wielding, both weapons hit with 30% less attack speed
description: Slam the ground, creating a branching Molten Fissure that deals damage as it travels and remains for a duration. Using a different Slam on a Molten Fissure creates a spreading Aftershock.
skillStats: Converts 80% of Physical damage to Fire damage
While Dual Wielding, both weapons hit with 30% less attack speed

beginner.whatItIs: A mace slam creating a branching Molten Fissure that damages as it travels and stays for twelve seconds, branching twice, with up to eight fissures active.
beginner.whyItMatters: Using a different slam on an existing fissure creates a spreading aftershock, so it is designed to be combined with your other slams rather than spammed alone.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Lay fissures across a fight, then slam on top of them with another skill. Dual wielding costs 30% attack speed here rather than damage.

name: Volcano
stats: Modifiers to cast speed also affect this skill's cost
150% more Eruption damage per additional Stage

Channelling this Skill for longer makes the initial eruption more violent, but does not affect subsequent Projectile sprays.
skillStats: Modifiers to cast speed also affect this skill's cost
150% more Eruption damage per additional Stage

beginner.whatItIs: A channelled spell raising a volcano that damages enemies standing on it and sprays molten projectiles every half second for eight seconds. Channelling longer makes the initial eruption up to four stages more violent.
beginner.whyItMatters: The extra channelling only improves the first eruption, so holding it longer is a burst decision rather than a general upgrade.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Channel fully against a boss and release quickly against trash. Slamming the volcano with another skill triggers extra projectile sprays, and only one can exist at a time.

Lightning damage from Hits with this skill Contributes to Electrocution Buildup
(150-340)% more Electrocution buildup from Hits with this skill
Electrocution buildup Debuff duration is 6 seconds

beginner.whatItIs: A crossbow grenade detonating after 2.5 seconds in a 2 to 2.4 metre lightning blast. For six seconds afterwards, all lightning hits against those enemies contribute to electrocution buildup, and this skill's own hits build it 150% to 340% faster.
beginner.whyItMatters: Electrocution is difficult to build without help, and this opens a window where your whole lightning kit contributes to it.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Throw it first, then unload lightning damage inside the six second window. Thrown after your burst it does almost nothing.

name: Voltaic Mark
stats: Marked enemy becomes Electrocuted when Hit while Primed for Electrocution
Buff grants 30% of damage Gained as Lightning damage
Hits against Marked enemy cause (25-35)% increased Electrocute buildup
description: Mark a target, making them more susceptible to being Electrocuted. When the Marked target is Electrocuted, the Mark Activates, granting a Buff which gives extra Lightning damage and Consuming the Mark. Marking another target while you have the Buff will remove the Buff.
skillStats: Marked enemy becomes Electrocuted when Hit while Primed for Electrocution
Buff grants 30% of damage Gained as Lightning damage
Hits against Marked enemy cause (25-35)% increased Electrocute buildup

beginner.whatItIs: A mark making the target electrocute when hit while primed, and granting hits against it 25% to 35% increased electrocute buildup. When the target is electrocuted the mark activates for a ten second buff giving 30% of damage as extra lightning.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is both the setup and the reward for electrocution, so one mark carries a debuff on them and a buff on you.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Mark the enemy you intend to electrocute, then keep the resulting buff by not marking anything else, since a new mark removes it.

name: Vulnerability
stats: Curse does not apply to enemies above level (20-0)
description: Curse all targets in an area after a short delay. making Hits against them ignore a portion of their Armour.
skillStats: Curse does not apply to enemies above level (20-0)

beginner.whatItIs: A curse applied to an area after a 1.5 second delay, reducing the targets' total armour so your hits ignore a portion of it, for six to seven seconds.
beginner.whyItMatters: Armour is what makes physical hits land softly, so removing it raises the damage of every physical hit that follows rather than adding damage itself.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Curse a group before a physical burst. Like the other curses it does not apply to enemies above a level threshold that shrinks as the gem levels.

name: Walking Calamity

For the duration of the Skill, meteors rain down around you and you Gain Fire damage and Rage regeneration. This Skill's effects are suppressed if you leave Bear form, but will resume if you return to Bear form before the duration expires.
skillStats: +0.3 seconds to base attack time if not standing

beginner.whatItIs: A bear shapeshift skill gated behind 50 Glory, earned by gaining Rage while already at maximum Rage. It rains meteors around you every 0.15 seconds for ten seconds while granting 30% of damage as fire and five Rage regenerated per second.
beginner.whyItMatters: Meteors fall 50% more often for each additional enemy nearby, up to 200%, so it is written to be used in a crowd rather than on a lone boss.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Release it inside a big pack while in bear form. Leaving bear form suppresses it, though returning in time resumes it.

name: War Banner
stats: Generates 100% of Monster Power as Glory for this Skill on Hitting with an Attack
description: While active, Attacking enemies builds Glory. When you have maximum Glory, you can place an inspiring Banner for a duration with an Aura that grants you and nearby Allies Attack damage, Attack speed and Accuracy.
skillStats: Generates 100% of Monster Power as Glory for this Skill on Hitting with an Attack

beginner.whatItIs: A banner placed once you have 200 Glory, built by attacking. Its aura covers 4.5 metres and grants you and allies 25% more attack damage, 25% increased attack speed and 50% increased accuracy for six to ten seconds.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is one of the larger party-wide attack buffs available, but it is stationary, so it decides where the fight happens.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Plant it where the group will hold, not where they are passing through. Glory is earned by hitting with attacks, so it fills during trash and pays out on the boss.

name: Wardbound Minions
stats: Summon one Wardbound Minion on Skill use and an additional Minion for each additional (11-59) Runic Ward spent
description: Spend all your Runic Ward to summon Temporary Wardbound Casters. These Minions target nearby enemies with damaging Cold Spells.
skillStats: Summon one Wardbound Minion on Skill use and an additional Minion for each additional (11-59) Runic Ward spent

beginner.whatItIs: A spell spending all your Runic Ward to summon temporary Wardbound Casters, up to twenty-four, which cast damaging cold spells for fifteen seconds or until they have cast six spells each.
beginner.whyItMatters: The number summoned scales directly with the ward you spent, so it converts a defensive pool into a burst of casters.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Cast it at full ward at the start of a fight. Casting at low ward summons one or two minions and wastes the skill.

name: Wave of Frost
stats: Converts 80% of Physical damage to Cold damage
description: Flip backwards and send forth a Freezing wave in front of you, immediately Freezing enemies which are Primed for Freeze.
skillStats: Converts 80% of Physical damage to Cold damage

beginner.whatItIs: A quarterstaff skill that flips you backwards and sends a freezing wave six metres forward, instantly freezing enemies primed for freeze, with 300% to 585% more chill magnitude and freeze buildup.
beginner.whyItMatters: The backward flip means it creates distance while it freezes, so it is defensive and offensive in the same press.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it when a pack has closed on you and you want both space and a freeze. Against unprimed enemies it still builds freeze heavily but will not freeze outright.

name: Whirling Assault
description: Advance while hitting enemies around you with a series of spinning Strikes.

beginner.whatItIs: A quarterstaff skill that advances while striking everything around you, with 1.4 metres of extra melee strike range and up to 20% more area of effect.
beginner.whyItMatters: It moves and damages at the same time over a wide radius, which is how a melee character walks through a crowd instead of around it.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Push it through a surrounding pack. It adds a full second to your attack time, so it is a commitment rather than a quick jab.

name: Whirling Slash
stats: Collapse deals 150% more damage per additional stage
description: Perform a circular slash that kicks up a Whirlwind around you, Slowing enemies and Blinding them in its area of effect. Leaving the area collapses the storm, dealing damage and causing Knockback.
skillStats: Collapse deals 150% more damage per additional stage

beginner.whatItIs: A spear slash raising a whirlwind around you that slows and blinds enemies inside it, up to three stages. Leaving the area collapses the storm for damage and knockback, dealing 150% more damage per additional stage.
beginner.whyItMatters: The damage is paid on exit rather than on cast, so the skill is about building stages and then walking away at the right moment.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Stack stages while enemies gather, then step out to collapse it. Leaving after one stage throws away most of the damage.

name: Whirlwind Lance
description: Throw a Spear with enough force to kick up a Whirlwind where it lands, Slowing enemies and Blinding them in its area of effect. Entering the Whirlwind collapses it, dealing damage and causing Knockback. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if possible to create the Whirlwind with one more than its normal maximum number of stages.

beginner.whatItIs: A thrown spear that raises a whirlwind where it lands, slowing and blinding enemies inside. Entering the whirlwind collapses it for damage and knockback.
beginner.whyItMatters: It places a whirlwind at range rather than around you, so you choose where the collapse happens and can set up for skills that consume whirlwinds.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Throw it into a group and then walk in to collapse it, or leave it standing as fuel for a skill like Twister. Consuming a Frenzy Charge gives it one extra stage.

name: Wild Protector
description: Call upon a Bear Spirit Companion to maul your foes. The Bear Spirit leaps at enemies to Maim them, Leeches Life with its slam, and periodically roars to Intimidate enemies. The Bear Spirit does not count toward your Companion limit.

beginner.whatItIs: A companion Bear Spirit that leaps at enemies to maim them, leeches life with its slam, and periodically roars to intimidate. It does not count towards your companion limit.
beginner.whyItMatters: Because it sits outside the companion limit, it is a free extra body on any build that already runs companions.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Take it on any character with spirit to spare, whether or not you play minions. Its maim and intimidate help a melee character as much as a summoner.

description: You are chosen by Azmerian spirits who provide guidance, allowing you to see nearby Ancient Blooms.
skillStats: Ancient Blooms fade after 25 seconds if not picked up

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent skill revealing Ancient Blooms within five metres and spawning one within 8.5 metres roughly every 1.2 to 1.4 seconds, with 5% to 100% increased effect.
beginner.whyItMatters: It creates a steady supply of pickups that would otherwise depend on the area you happen to be in.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Run it on a build that pays off Ancient Blooms and keeps moving, since blooms fade after twenty-five seconds if you do not collect them.

name: Wind Blast
description: Batter enemies at range by generating a gust of wind as you swing. Enemies will be Dazed and Knocked Back based on how close they are to you.

beginner.whatItIs: A quarterstaff swing generating a gust down a 6 metre cone, dazing enemies and knocking them back harder the closer they are, with 150% more stun buildup.
beginner.whyItMatters: It gives a melee weapon a ranged crowd control tool, which is what a quarterstaff build reaches for when a pack is closing.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Swing it as enemies approach so the knockback resets their distance. The daze it applies is also the setup that Vaulting Impact needs.

name: Wind Dancer
stats: On being Hit by an Enemy, consume all stages to trigger Gale Force
description: While active, periodically grants stages of a buff that gives you more Evasion per stage. Being Hit by an Enemy while you have this buff consumes all stages to damage and Knock Back enemies around you.
skillStats: On being Hit by an Enemy, consume all stages to trigger Gale Force

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent buff granting a stage every one to one and a half seconds, up to three, each giving 10% more evasion rating. Being hit consumes all stages to damage and knock back enemies around you.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is defence that turns into a counterattack, so the moment your evasion fails is also the moment you hit back.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Run it on an evasion character who is rarely hit, so the stages have time to build. On a character hit constantly it never reaches three stages.

stats: 200% more Knockback Distance against Unique Enemies
description: Consume all Frenzy Charges to perform a gigantic spear thrust that Knocks Back enemies. For each Frenzy Charge consumed, a Wind Serpent follows in the spear's wake. Each Serpent also damages and Knocks Back enemies.
skillStats: 200% more Knockback Distance against Unique Enemies

beginner.whatItIs: A spear thrust ten metres long and 1.7 metres wide that consumes all Frenzy Charges, sending one Wind Serpent in its wake per charge. Serpents also damage and knock back, with 200% more knockback distance against uniques.
beginner.whyItMatters: Its size is set entirely by your charge count, so a build that generates charges quickly gets a very different skill than one that does not.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Fire it at full charges down a line of enemies. It needs at least one Frenzy Charge to be used at all.

name: Wing Blast
stats: 15% Surpassing chance to grant a Power Charge on Heavy Stun, modified by Monster Power
description: Shapeshift into a Wyvern and launch yourself backwards with a powerful wingbeat that Knocks Back enemies. Enemies Primed for Heavy Stun will be stunned, release a shockwave, and have a chance to grant you a Power Charge. This skill can be used while using other skills to interrupt them.
skillStats: 15% Surpassing chance to grant a Power Charge on Heavy Stun, modified by Monster Power

beginner.whatItIs: A wyvern shapeshift wingbeat launching you backwards six metres and knocking enemies back. Enemies primed for heavy stun are stunned, release a shockwave, and have a chance to grant you a Power Charge.
beginner.whyItMatters: It can be used while other skills are running to interrupt them, which is an escape option most attack skills do not offer.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Press it to cancel a committed attack when something dangerous is incoming. It cannot cause stun buildup itself, so the stun only lands on already primed enemies.

name: Withering Presence
stats: Withers enemies in your Presence every (1.8-1.42) seconds
description: While active, emits an Aura that periodically Withers enemies in your Presence.
skillStats: Withers enemies in your Presence every (1.8-1.42) seconds

beginner.whatItIs: A persistent aura that applies Withered to enemies in your Presence every 1.4 to 1.8 seconds, lasting six seconds each time.
beginner.whyItMatters: Withered raises the chaos damage a target takes, and stacking it automatically means a chaos build never spends a cast on the debuff.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Run it on any chaos or poison build. It gives nothing to a character dealing no chaos damage.

name: Wolf Pack
description: Activate to summon a pack of Wolf Companions. The pack treated as a single Companion for effects that count or limit Companions, regardless of the number of Wolves in the pack.

beginner.whatItIs: A companion skill summoning a pack of three to six wolves that count as a single companion for any effect that limits or counts companions.
beginner.whyItMatters: Getting up to six bodies for the price of one companion slot is a large amount of pressure for a single reservation.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Take it on a build with spirit to spare, especially a werewolf one, since several werewolf skills specifically buff or move wolves alongside you.
